body:

This November, our very Democracy is on the ballot, and Pennsylvania is at the center of it all. That’s why I’m supporting Bob Casey for U.S. Senate.
**[Donate to Bob Casey ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241007-4?recurring=1&refcode=em20241007-4&refcode2=4483_552475_afxGiY&akid=4483%2E552475%2EafxGiY)**
If we’re going to stop Donald Trump, take back the House, and defend our Senate majority, we must keep this battleground blue. Bob Casey is running to make sure we defend our Senate majority and protect voting rights from attack.
But here’s the deal: national Republicans have made Pennsylvania’s Senate seat a top target this year. Bob Casey is facing $150 million worth of attacks – more than almost any other race this cycle – and multiple polls show him tied with his Trump-endorsed opponent, David McCormick.

At this point, all the chips are going down on the table. 2024's elections are less than a month away and opponents of voting rights are all in.
Now the press, the pundits, and the political strategists are all watching to see if we -- along with our pro-democracy partners -- can produce record-breaking pro-voter turnout across the country to help defend ballot access, drop boxes, mail-in voting, and so much more. We have the grassroots team to get the job done, but we need your help to get over the finish line.
Team, can you fuel our work with $25 or more for our Voter Mobilization Fund today and help turn out the vote in crucial states? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-gotv?refcode=100724_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=100724_3&amount=25]
One month to go, Folks.
There are just 31 days between now and Election Day that we have to stand up for voting rights and defend our democracy against the voter suppression we've seen put in place since the last election.
By reaching out to voters right now — to get them registered to vote, help them make a plan to vote, and ask them to reach out to their friends and family to do the same — we can get turn out voters in record numbers and truly make an impact to protect early voting, mail-in ballots, and more.
This month will not be easy and it will prove to be a great test of our democracy — but we have to win, Team. Chip in $25 or whatever you can to confirm your commitment and fuel our GOTV work for this last critical month! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-gotv?refcode=100724_3&amount=25]

body:
As president of our local union, I led the strike.
_[Click here to stop receiving emails about Dan Osborn's campaign in Nebraska from us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94511538/503732003/1647001491?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNzI1OTczZi0wODg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L1BY94eE8GDdKjeasjlTPqW9GkAC2ZI_VT0ZQLZpXtI=&emci=ca99a22d-5a84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=1725973f-0885-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=19445147)_
Hey there,
In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we had diapers to buy and needed health insurance for our growing family.
When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after.
But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
**So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94511539/503732009/92586991?refcode=em20241007pm3-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=1725973f-0885-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNzI1OTczZi0wODg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L1BY94eE8GDdKjeasjlTPqW9GkAC2ZI_VT0ZQLZpXtI=)
It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks, and the company threatening to permanently replace every union worker, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying jobs here in Nebraska alone.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94511540/503732017/92586991?refcode=em20241007pm3-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=1725973f-0885-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNzI1OTczZi0wODg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L1BY94eE8GDdKjeasjlTPqW9GkAC2ZI_VT0ZQLZpXtI=)
Following the strike, I was fired. The company has its version of events for why, but I believe it was because I was union president. Someone had to pay – and my head was on the chopping block.
It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.
**Instead, I’ve decided to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and with your help, we are going to defeat her.**
Two brand-new polls now show me LEADING Republican Deb Fischer, and according to experts at FiveThirtyEight, Nebraska is now the CLOSEST Senate race in the entire country.

clean_body: As president of our local union, I led the strike. Hey there, In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years. I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we had diapers to buy and needed health insurance for our growing family. When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after. But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers. So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike. = It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class. After 11 weeks, and the company threatening to permanently replace every union worker, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying jobs here in Nebraska alone. It was one of the proudest moments of my life. = Following the strike, I was fired. The company has its version of events for why, but I believe it was because I was union president. Someone had to pay – and my head was on the chopping block. It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me. Instead, I’ve decided to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and with your help, we are going to defeat her. | **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

Hi Friend, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I personally wrote this email.
[**If you already know why we need Elissa Slotkin in the U.S. Senate, click here right now—really, every dollar helps!—and have a great rest of your night!**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241007-4-900&t=3&akid=2027%2E135344%2EsBktK9)
Elissa is an incredible candidate with a compelling story. You might know that she served three tours in Iraq alongside our military before working in national security under two presidents. But I want to share with you some of our recent conversations in which I learned why being a public servant is personal for Elissa.
After comforting families and survivors of not just one but two school shootings in Michigan (Oxford and Michigan State University), Elissa became even more fierce in her determination to stop the #1 killer of children in the United States: gun violence.
“People protested against seat belts in the 80s,” she told me, “but common sense prevailed, and millions of lives have been saved. We need to get this done!”
We CAN get this done if we elect people like Elissa who aren’t beholden to the gun lobby. People with common sense. People who care.

body:
| Friend -

For those of you not following every detail of my Senate race, I wanted to let you know that tomorrow I'll be debating my opponent, Mike Rogers, for the first time.

As a refresher, despite painting himself as a moderate in the 20 years he was a politician, he has done what so many have unfortunately done before him: said whatever he thinks he needs to say to win this seat. In many cases, that means giving up on portraying himself as a moderate and touting Trump’s extreme positions as an election denier. In other cases, he thinks his 20-year voting record won't matter and he has tried to position himself as more reasonable on things like choice.

But one thing about debates is that there is a lot of preparation and practice before the actual event.

So the last week has been all about "debate prep."

It also means there's virtually no time for fundraising. That's fine. It is not my favorite part of the job by any stretch. But it also means I am hoping supporters like you can help fill that gap.

It's especially important given the recent outside spending against us and the need to be ready for anything that comes our way after the debate.

clean_body: | Friend - For those of you not following every detail of my Senate race, I wanted to let you know that tomorrow I'll be debating my opponent, Mike Rogers, for the first time. As a refresher, despite painting himself as a moderate in the 20 years he was a politician, he has done what so many have unfortunately done before him: said whatever he thinks he needs to say to win this seat. In many cases, that means giving up on portraying himself as a moderate and touting Trump’s extreme positions as an election denier. In other cases, he thinks his 20-year voting record won't matter and he has tried to position himself as more reasonable on things like choice. But one thing about debates is that there is a lot of preparation and practice before the actual event. So the last week has been all about "debate prep." subject: 6 fun ways to teach kids about voting
body:
And if you know any kids who will be eligible to vote, I have resources for you! | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us8.campaign-archive.com/?e=7e921d898f&u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=3c725a15ed)
---
| | | Hi Peter,
While kids can’t vote until they turn 18 years old, voting can still be a family affair! In fact, research shows that seeing that you value and exercise your right to vote helps ensure your kids become lifelong voters, too.
There are so many fun ways to [teach the kids](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=34ee1a2c7c&e=7e921d898f) in your life about voting, so check out this helpful guide with lots of great ideas to get you started!
---
[Get the guide](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=32466a0680&e=7e921d898f)
| And, if you have any kids in your family who will turn 18 before election day, it’s time to get them registered to vote! Head to [studentvote.org](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=abe663eb34&e=7e921d898f) for all the resources and info they’ll need to vote for the very first time!
---
[Studentvote.org](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=2be7528fee&e=7e921d898f)
| | | Voting helps us make the future brighter for younger generations, AND it teaches them the skills they’ll need to speak up for themselves as they get older. So talk to the kids in your life about voting today, and help us build a brighter future for kids everywhere. 💖
---
| All the best,**Nani**

Fellow American,

California may produce some of the most left-wing politicians in the country, such as Kamala Harris. But ironically, it’s also once again our key to a Republican House majority.

**Kevin Lincoln** is running in a battleground House race in CA-9 that presents one of our best opportunities to flip a Democrat-held seat in a deep blue state.

Kevin and I have a lot in common:

* He’s a minority
* He’s a military veteran
* He loves God and is a family man

Voters need to hear Sarah’s message.
#
We wanted to make sure you didn’t miss this exciting update:
Our ads are live in Delaware! **But with just 4 weeks left until Election Day, we need your help to keep them running.**
[**Can you chip in $5 to keep Sarah’s message on air?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241007-1?refcode=em20241007-1-1351&refcode2=1351_21716_8g16Ac&akid=1351%2E21716%2E8g16Ac)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241007-1?amount=5&refcode=em20241007-1-1351&refcode2=1351_21716_8g16Ac&akid=1351%2E21716%2E8g16Ac)**
Your support is crucial right now. Every contribution helps us reach more voters with Sarah’s message.
Thank you for being a part of this,
Team McBride
_P.S. In case you missed our message last week, you can read it below!_
* * *
**We recently launched our first TV ads in Delaware — the largest and oldest Congressional district.** We’re so excited that voters are seeing our ads and getting the chance to hear directly from Sarah.
But here’s the situation: running TV ads is a lot more expensive than online advertising, mail pieces, and text messages.**In fact, it’s one of the biggest expenses of our campaign.**
It’s going to take _a lot_ of grassroots donations to pay for our ads each week. [**That’s why we’re asking you to donate to our TV ads fund. Can you pitch in $5 or even $7.50 to keep Sarah’s message on the air through Election Day? We can’t afford to go dark.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241007-1?refcode=em20241007-1-1351&refcode2=1351_21716_8g16Ac&akid=1351%2E21716%2E8g16Ac)
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241007-1?refcode=em20241007-1-1351&refcode2=1351_21716_8g16Ac&akid=1351%2E21716%2E8g16Ac)
TV ads show voters who might not know who Sarah is, what she stands for, and why she’s the best choice to fight for us in Congress. And polling shows that when voters learn about Sarah, she wins.
**With 32 days until Election Day, it’s mission-critical that we inform and persuade undecided voters — but we can’t keep our current ads live or launch new ads without the resources.**
Right now, we really want voters in the northern part of Delaware to see our ads — but that means going up on the air in Philadelphia’s crowded and expensive media market. Sarah will be competing for critical air time, and it won’t come cheap. **So, we could really use your help today.**
[**Can you pitch into our TV ads fund now? Every dollar makes a difference.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241007-1?refcode=em20241007-1-1351&refcode2=1351_21716_8g16Ac&akid=1351%2E21716%2E8g16Ac)

Thank you!
Team McBride

We need your support more than ever. Gillen has Soros, and Soros has the deep pockets and control of the media machine. But we have something much more powerful—the people of Long Island, who are tired of lies, manipulation, and seeing their communities sold out to the highest bidder. The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Join the fight against Critical Race Theory
body:
I’m reaching out because you’re an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zt5hgiunmlaksp43otu71pe8u6hq20g9oeu3635o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0spgeaoj2cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6rg3stcd2flbf3daor40s017faamh98ns5mq25g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0spgeaoj2cph2bs)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zan9u9659rq13vhjsueuimnt7tgqiula0v6e4g9o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0spgeaoj2cph2bs)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Your participation and support are essential in our fight against CRT. Please complete the survey and consider a generous gift to help us continue our educational mission at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrn10vclckhfr1q5e9l4nvpp5u58688rhqe42bq8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0spgeaoj2cph2bs)

informed Americans think about the radical agenda of the

So please help us today by taking your personalized survey-your

I firmly believe, and I hope you agree, that a proper

At a time when the far-Left explicitly rejects the principles

to save America: EDUCATION.

Together, we can fight back with the truth.

Thank you for your time, and thank you in advance for your
survey responses.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

# **VP Pick is JD Vance: A Threat to Democracy**
---
| | | | | [ ](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2v03yk-fbiq6b-kyd76rh0/)
---
| | | | This is big news, folks, Ever since JD Vance was selected to be Trump's running mate, there has been more on the line in this election than ever before. This choice goes beyond mere campaign strategy and tactics, raising critical questions about the future direction of the country. Vance is an election denier who has switched his position on numerous key issues, proving he cannot be trusted with the office of Vice President. JD Vance's political evolution has been marked by a dramatic shift from initial criticism of Trump to becoming one of his most ardent supporters. In 2016, Vance referred to Trump as an “idiot,” “noxious,” and “reprehensible,” questioning whether Trump would be a “cynical a---- like Nixon” or “America’s Hitler.” Once Trump won the election, Vance quickly changed his tune. Vance has since embraced Trump's agenda wholeheartedly. He has articulated a vision for a radical transformation of American governance, suggesting that Trump should overhaul the civil service, replace existing bureaucrats with loyalists, and defy judicial constraints. Vance has proven time and time again that he is willing to pursue extreme measures to achieve his political goals. Vance's role in the Senate and his association with the "New Right," a group advocating for government intervention in cultural and economic matters to advance a right-wing agenda, show his radical agenda for what it is. Vance’s endorsement of foreign authoritarian figures, such as Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, further underscores his anti-democratic inclinations. Orbán’s control over media and educational institutions serves as a model for Vance’s vision of governance, wherein dissenting voices are suppressed, and power is centralized. This authoritarian admiration positions Vance as not merely a supporter of Trump’s ambitions but an active proponent of dismantling democratic institutions around the world. Knowing all of this, we can only imagine what Vance's course of action would have been if he was in Mike Pence's shoes on January 6th. Pence's refusal to support Trump's attempt to overturn the 2020 election was a critical moment in defending democratic norms. In contrast, Vance’s alignment with Trump’s most authoritarian impulses makes him a candidate who would not only comply with but actively pursue anti-democratic actions. JD Vance’s selection as Trump’s running mate is a significant threat to American democracy. [**_Vance poses a substantial threat to democracy. His vision of a government that aggressively pursues a right-wing agenda does not align with what voters around the country need in a Vice President. His presence on the ticket not only bolsters Trump’s chances but also significantly jeopardizes the democratic fabric of the United States. Stand with us in our fight to defeat these election deniers and defend democracy._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2v03yk-fbiq6c-kyd76rh1/)

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=15218d2e9b6e47aa82a88991df6b051f&_e=WIi_iuDSm9Vt66UZQOOB-9Tc8J0bjQTsntbZxyg0TZypdYecqntxGmCULP89BnAjKsPUfAzgYTtzrjDIuF0QIbD6FW5ikIO0XDBkX1DxxZbGNcLVBgP9dGoxqHzp7eMU65H01Wb1GkRPeGs6WT5nYZkGzlnVm2S9_x70NkVOFU6azOfCjdl06rsxOZJRLrg9qQ-wq1P6q2E6eI4Zu-A4AwOZCZ2VRduT8HWkXZucMrq6opRsmJBYZeY-pRquqdcx_u8rWhUdv2CBjQETxl3OaGUto8cyc6m6Iiiwvb8stI2AJO5FFsT0AW1JeRy0-S0B_jD6ejJpnzrAcuoqyhk8uDamvlMFFkn2349YKiE8dIuUPvSjweecQfLBdXVZLWaq)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=15218d2e9b6e47aa82a88991df6b051f&_e=WIi_iuDSm9Vt66UZQOOB-9Tc8J0bjQTsntbZxyg0TZypdYecqntxGmCULP89BnAjKsPUfAzgYTtzrjDIuF0QIbD6FW5ikIO0XDBkX1DxxZbGNcLVBgP9dGoxqHzp7eMU65H01Wb1GkRPeGs6WT5nYZkGzlnVm2S9_x70NkVOFU6azOfCjdl06rsxOZJRLrg9qQ-wq1P6q2E6eI4Zu-A4AwOZCZ2VRduT8HWkXZucMroyD28Kz-P_ffj-DTOahEmMcXsvOLEUdc58MQ5cmy5Gjr433x4PY88PiMqeuqcBo7Lswp0X7kGX1BwZ6OmpS_xtwD1wsvC9HOME69EFM3FHQpAui4nxAm8Mv8cMovpaUvLi_tbRi_4dXTo9X56scEEI)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=511a072e480846d7bc05f27369dc3c27&_e=ziAex0znidJUcuNPcBRMdzHrs8Daj3Y0s5OVagMcPrKTvpOFQaMw8grqKrHIcsW3oYkOVVQQ9DOTjeg6zLpRPQBsV9cbOzLyZ6EbhglpYcqo8irc4cxMeIGxoEXbzaluSCs3tnvu2DZT9Plh8MxqoWTE0aTxUtK1ICJlQpZpT6Qd_3V27QPVFV6r88TFCSdxOb6sJCUsQGPe7MhajuA-jwwplN4ppx_XYA_ewIZWkib2DlAczdswsn8eXF6uK0xnha8h8eQaQk2nqF36NCpaF3KeQjhj6zdklC6rPehZE_TvZduMjcUNZtsD2Yd2l-miXffP9k99phzYtJ2SGLOAuuolxkoBLtvw7C3dlIcgbIittv4FMzEyUEIKIDK9aoQC)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=511a072e480846d7bc05f27369dc3c27&_e=ziAex0znidJUcuNPcBRMdzHrs8Daj3Y0s5OVagMcPrKTvpOFQaMw8grqKrHIcsW3oYkOVVQQ9DOTjeg6zLpRPQBsV9cbOzLyZ6EbhglpYcqo8irc4cxMeIGxoEXbzaluSCs3tnvu2DZT9Plh8MxqoWTE0aTxUtK1ICJlQpZpT6Qd_3V27QPVFV6r88TFCSdxOb6sJCUsQGPe7MhajuA-jwwplN4ppx_XYA_ewIZWkiaqI2fPaF0HNrvlHt4--PVw0knmoX-JeFuHB9CjV1aj1fvUy4hX6egsGOt-76ClS5sgZhSDjFsY2uDntgSYJ36pNB5fVoeFloXd7aufYiq2qke_naA3s0R95CN8MHnyuvINpxqcJORNB77EJB39a7QK)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

| Hi—

You've probably gotten lots of emails already about how critical it is to elect Kamala Harris this November if we’re going to secure a safer climate future.

So, my ask for you today is short and simple: **Check your voter registration status, and make a plan to vote.** Our friends at Climate Power have made it super easy with [this one-stop-shop for you to update your registration, request a mail-in ballot, and research what else will be on your specific ballot.](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2927739/87SdQ4wZ) |

I just went to my local Board of Elections office to request, receive, vote and submit a mail-in ballot all in one visit, and it was super easy! **Find out what early voting options exist in your state.**
---

Each year, millions of Americans find themselves unable to vote simply because they missed a registration deadline, moved but didn't update their registration status, or didn't make a plan.

We must do everything we can to make sure that every eligible climate voter has the tools they need to make their voices heard so that climate and communities **win** this November.

## Hurricane Milton Upgraded to Category 5
Hurricane Milton has strengthened to a [Category 5 storm](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u8zAMAJ_G3hyI1B89aPiWbPnWjoYiUzEL2QoUNUHfvkjnjodbDvdxWS5Rihy3_3Hn0HNdYury5AXURBOaxYxryMzIeuQAHknP5Lwbt2AjzGQVWwDMzmYXvSVOGmxiyus8SkCFBpQiUJoUna4KQTuzEnuTI6fBKF6l13b6rHL0jXP5rk9up1T3sYSt9_tj0P8GPA94jveDX4-3ekPrkgoPeN6-WpMUD552Kb0e08aFD55yqU3WOFnrk00WELRlFck5uOJMbCyDTzOOLaz3l5QiD-cHo257lPIb0P_e8Qz4EwAA__-C_2A4) with 175 mph winds, threatening Florida's Gulf Coast with potential 12-foot storm surges, and is expected to make landfall near Tampa Bay on Wednesday.Officials are preparing for what could be the largest evacuation since Hurricane Irma in 2017, less than two weeks after Hurricane Helene devastated parts of Florida.Gov. Ron DeSantis declared a [state of emergency for 51 counties](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHOnDAQhJ_GdIvMYsBXuEjj7k-bEu3hNfhkMLJ9kLx9dFHKvxxpRqPv-_U1f1GI4Vh_0s6m-jTTUsPFcydBA6pZNc54ZuS-YdNNqPuHHqex2cyo3OD8s3tIyQ9Sg3uSUoMeelxk78ehCQYlqk5K3cleS90-JXb9qJzmSXniRSjJLtSU21cKR93Yxz_p4twuaW-i2Wo9i-h_CLQC7X3f7cF3US_6_SkItJ8o0PqYcnAk0H7-BNpOCrRyEmjXdIHjQkcNBdZwcYH36agyUIH_Ozgzn5S5gE8ZIuWVoSwUGfii5U01pKMAbUwOkoftnXNY6GDYQ6zpEGibbNx5hxhDGSeh5LpTiP8g6vdKL4N_AwAA__8h53pG) and announced preparations, including stockpiling water and fuel.President Biden signed a disaster declaration Monday, [authorizing federal aid](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8GNiI4E4wHhi7e0rWjdYZzfBWGyKBE_fuq7dr5PelJ7-O23JAzl_s7HhT6VheMnZ-0GK28ArtYmcJGBDRICmYEP0zejU7ugQy6NVpYEaJx5uqvHqN3ftIxGYNJcgAN1mjtjR689pdVgxmcTZ5GuyFFYTUl7vW8fFYufactf9UnnZdYD5nD3vujieFNwCxg7jvtnPMPEzDv9aBCryZgxnRw4dZP7FyLgNlOZnJmUisnKqrxvTSVuGHrdKpEMeOfqrZcT04oYJZnSI8X58zNjcLq-4H8m5L9_ynPAN8BAAD__84XZVw) for over 30 Florida counties.
## Mission Tests Planetary Defense Plan
The European Space Agency's _Hera_ mission, [aimed at planetary defense](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu6yAUgOGnsTcsOBCDB4a7ZMtdO1oncIhpMViGhubtq3bu_ku_9L3d1hvGFPPjP-5kWygruhaftArODAO1qtHbQAQkR7JCg5GLmfU8bjYAgNaeFi5dWC6EdxlIw4xCO3fXbowWOCjBuRFcGm6mOwchZ-UNaRWQ3KA4-djKOb2XmNtGIb3Kk87JlX1MdmvtqIP8N8B1gGvvfcrUayf6-AkGuNYDHbEvlvAzu40qOxJmani-mKdAuRLb6ES2x1pjyQxro7NEz8QyX4SA8bT-6DGlWGc9KP7YMabfefub4mnhOwAA__-ZnGLJ) against killer asteroids, successfully launched on SpaceX's _Falcon 9_ from Florida, beginning its journey to a distant asteroid system over 60 million miles away.The Hera mission is part of [a global effort](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOszAQhJ_GdEbrxdhO4eJv3OVvr0QbvASfAEfYCcfbn5L6qmlmNJ--r-twpbSk7f6fVvZ1ygONNb14UCCdRD3oJvqJGblr2CuLrrs4Y00z-xFpInaKwJkxuks0N2dAR-rpYq3mJnkE1ArAKegcuPYGqDqjo2OrJ-JRaOCYat7b75y2OvO0nPnFezvmtVn8XOujiO6fwCAwHMfRPgvVHOl8FwSGUvN-CgwbH-UdVFPeBIb3rcCgQGAAKzBwITnzTnJNpaS8yYWe2zjL8qCRf2Spz3hKKpX3nKLAYPu-18Yo-Kyb3cfHkZYlFWOFhvtKafkw1r-NvTz-BgAA___43GwJ) to develop a defense system following NASA's successful 2022 test, which redirected a rogue asteroid by intentionally crashing a spacecraft into it.When it arrives two years from now, Hera will examine NASA's crash site to confirm if the impact was successful. It will also analyze surface minerals and gravity, which will help refine future missions. [You can see mission images here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1vwyAUAH8NbFh8xdCBoUu2dO1ovcAjfhU2liF2---rZu520g2n-7xNN6BC6-MDFgw91wlipwMnJYUX2k6Wp5ARNRqOQTntzZsf3cjnENMYXbpLlRCzyQZMdEZ7VBd5seiQU9BSWyWlV9J46Ye71MqMNnl0NgNGZiUm6nUfviqtfcZcfuqB-xDrwkuYe98aM-9MX5m-nuc5tA0i_lmmry_-FthAzLiDgNZxr5TEQq1RXUWB5xpn0Z4xYmt8D2k7qRRqo2NWPhag8gr1_7ePoH8DAAD__xOFXFE).

A recent study ranked [North Dakota as the hardest-working](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FurDAQQNGvMZ2RPfiBKVy8hm7TpkSzeFhPYtYIz4Ly91FSp7_S1Xm_zTfkzM_HG24UZC0zLsInzdZor8HNrolhJQLqGgp2AN-Nvh_6JoVxHEc3IFiK_j4Src50_waD_dpDtOAbDmDAWWO8NZ03vr0bsF3voqfBrUiLcoYiSznaj8JPSbTmr3LS0S5la3JIIntV3X8Fk4Lpuq725PrCvODOgpmr_IQKpg33naJ-6aqroFDVklD0VY5PLYl0wiNSFQVTc4S4X5wz135Qzjw25Py7k7_xZ4DvAAAA__-dU11e) state in America, while West Virginia was identified as the least hardworking state.To determine which states have the hardest-working Americans, personal finance company WalletHub [compared 50 states](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGngY3oOIhNBoYu3tK1o0XMYV-LTYSJrb591c6d_-HX93Ef74Ezb_N7WMm3VMYwNT5o1KCcQjtaGX0iQjKSvO7RmZvr-k4u3qA2Bh6JultMkCKB1fGWTLzSFWMAyR4BrQZwGowDd3kAatPZ6Ki3KdAkLFDkVurls_DWFkr5uxxUL1NZZfZLa89dmDeBg8DhDDlTW16P3ypwoPgSOCyhRtqbOkv94m1WewuNdsWbCitVnoLA4YoWQFYfnyfnzHvXCwvzGjj_jdr_7MPjTwAAAP__dDNaVg) using ten key indicators, including average workweek hours, the share of workers with multiple jobs, and average daily leisure time.According to the data, the Midwestern states, mostly major agricultural areas, are the hardest-working, with ratings decreasing toward both coasts. Other states in the top five were Alaska, Nebraska, Wyoming, and South Dakota. ## Supreme Court Lets Texas Abortion Ban Stand
The U.S. Supreme Court [declined to hear a case](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j71uwyAURp8Gb1iXCwZ7YOjiLV07WvxcJ0g4RJjE7ttXyd7tG76jo_NzWS4u5XS_fruNbDvXsrjQ0osWAXzkqBbVReshTqIjKwyOcpzMJLubRem1NyAhDBKnYRii1k4Zr8MEciXskkVAJQBGAYNG2QsPRpMBGVfhJz8yBRRTK7VvN2p0un3Nv-VFtQ9l67K9tfbYmfxiODOcj-Po13KqOx37-8Bwfk-G8wflzpfaUrnz_fmotBEP5VkbL6Fx01UbH0fKOe3aMAXXzaX8sbR_ol8W_wIAAP__dYlaKg) concerning whether Texas' abortion ban contradicts federal law requiring hospitals to provide abortions if the mother's life is at risk. This decision was issued without explanation and [upholds a lower court's ruling](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LuOgzAQheGnMZ2RPVwMhYtt6LLtlsiXAaw1OLInkLz9Kum3PtLRp__nNt9MiOFYv82Omp5Lmo2jcOIsBR84tHNbeW2FH2WFWioYmmFUY1NtundeWuhcJ9B1TTdKNYIZl6V3AMpKUQUNAlopxCBF10NTSytUj0o0fpF2tANrBfpAKde0IeHTlCW-0om5dmmvot6I7oU1XwwmBtN1XfXvRc_3yGB6fzOYpGAwCcVgKo97xh25S49MPCIVXsgcnnt0oYR0cGtyDsfKcce84uFe3NiUKaSjcNoM8TOkaAj5x8KtORhMVdb-foUYQ-kVa8W6mxA_QPqn16nhLwAA__90sm5h) that blocked the Biden administration's efforts to require Texas hospitals to follow federal law. Attorneys for the state have argued Texas law allows a woman to get an abortion if her life is in danger, although the Texas Medical Board has [struggled to provide guidance](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2KwzAQhJ_G7hx2tYp-ChXXpMu1Vxr9rBOBEhlLJL63P5z-uvkYGIbv5zpffS75efv2D3Z9X-rsY88vnhEmMwk5yzG5AMniyA61MGSstjTeXSJ19oq8TdpEIVjJIKJCRCCSGGHMToCQCGAQzkrQCQNoxRooLRhsMIMETrnX7dTv3Hn3bSm_9cXbKdbHWNy997UN9DWIyyAufn3yux3VAVvPsfCRQt16rs_pMzDxHnk9uE2pxl63NnmUhqwnMIGS1toGQ0rrgIH14jGOm0vrO5eSm9KDhNvD5_K50P8x8nLiLwAA___BR2H_) identifying what conditions would qualify for this exception.
## West Texas Geyser Still Going
The 100-foot geyser that erupted near Toyah on Wednesday last week [continues to spew water and oil](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGurCAURb8GOwwcUKGgeI3dvPaWBuE4kiAYIDrz9zcz_a139srK-nksDxtiSM__9kDTXlterGvhwoUzqijIRXberMxr3qHhEyih9KRFt5vRoUUxDE5sHFbH3erlqKQWfoJByaELBhhIzpjibBhB9Hxl04gTE37jq14VkQx9aLn0bceGL1u3-M4Xlt7lo4tmb-2sRPwjMBOY7_vu3V5y-qwE5oR3JTBXFzA5pJiuUHI6MDUCsy0tuIifG9ZGv3D6xHfFQnOI9LYNC-VacS3HoT_3syvGn3eIMdRxIpI9DxviV6T90eUy8BsAAP__OApmRw), baffling experts and drawing attention from locals, journalists, and environmental advocates. Officials with the Texas Railroad Commission believe the geyser is coming from an abandoned oil well, but they aren't sure who owns it. In June, a ranch about 100 miles away in Pecos County saw several plugged oil wells [come back to life](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FuwyAQgOGngc0WdxADA0MXb-na0QJzJEg4RDYyydtXzd791yf9P9fl6nPJj9u338i1V6qLX1s-aQExmAHVonh0QUQLnBxoNNJYbSW_uxVMCmG9aJFsioQ6WQATwE-TloY8zw4FKhDCgLhMKEcIQk-khYwJgg2GKUExt7qP7U6NXv5I5V1P2se1bry4e2vPg8kvhjPDufc-Jn-0tW5P_3j_NQxnC6AQrGY4f4Sh5jJ0KuUYum-0893FZ8-l5GPSTInb5nP5-O2f3dPhbwAAAP__ugZXoA) in a less spectacular fashion. Some industry experts believe the leaks are due to seismic activity in the Permian Basin, where fracking is frequently used to extract oil and natural gas. Energy infrastructure company Kinder Morgan is on-site trying to contain the geyser, and the Federal Aviation Administration has [implemented a no-fly zone](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LvO4yAUBOCnwd2xAN-goEjjarPtlhY2BxsFQwQkJPv0q0Ta8q9mpGk-zZ_rctXOu7D_1ieq8rJx0VtxT1wYBQG8X_rGqJUayRpUbOKiE3KSXXMozq0ccLBWCLshY1M3UJQTHzqJo2bYOMUp7xmlgtFh5F3LVjqNONHOWLbKVZCeonElprYcWPCls_Xv-MTUbvFsvDpKuWfSXQifCZ9rre2Zw2cjfMYAj0z4HLB-4n-HEMH6N_yNASE_UoqPYDLoANF5sA69gR3fGRPcXDCY4Ixp1wFCrFBjumUoEbYYSooeyoFQMRf44iC7goTPOsHlwtIvOecmKXOvznuXx4n0dD-18199-eHMp-L_AgAA___EIHnu) in the area.
## Texas Cities Ranked at High Risk for Natural Disaster
A new list of the safest cities in the country ranks more than a dozen in Texas as particularly [at risk of a natural disaster](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1urDAQRp_GdEb-WzCFi9vQ7W1TogEPMIoXr-wJbN4-2vTpvuKTjs75uE93oETH9h8eGPi15gkWphMnraSXxk2uiWFWcdANBt0bb_3QD7bZg7YmGu-j9W65IQ4Q7ax7rzrtYFk9NBSMMk4r5bW6dca2elZ9h72ycdXzMHvhFEbiXFrekfEFdU3f-cTSLvnRpLAzP6uw_4QZhRmv62rX_HIHXvV9EGZ8T2FGKicdm9wKHFE-C1AhlFDeWpwPudO2Y2V5AH8VSDJShcpYZKH62ZQQnxelRLXrhVPbAyj98vmPHGcwPwEAAP__F9ZlOg). The [WalletHub ranking of 182 cities](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z79uwyAQgPGnwZuj40wwHhi6eEvXjtYBR3wSjiND_vTtq3bv_Emf9Pu6LBeSIrfrJ23s2zvvC8UmT1409K5Hs5gu-QBp0h17PaIb3DROQ7d6y-fs2AFYDBQhUTTTwGedM4ENGDrxCGg0gNNwtjicdIDR8ghDyjpMwSkDnKTtx6mt3PhNNZfv_cnHKe5bV_za2r2q4UPhrHB-USnc1kf4rQpnTg-Fc6XMtfVRmnDt5dbTxodEUjgbPaHtDp_uLylFqh2VgetGUv7-7R_u0-NPAAAA___R3FeE) scored the 150 largest cities in the country (plus the two largest cities in each state) on home and community safety, financial safety, and natural disaster risk. Houston was ranked most at risk of a natural disaster, while seven cities in the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex were ranked 171st or lower. San Antonio was ranked 162, Amarillo 154th, and Austin 142nd. Laredo and El Paso were the only cities in Texas ranked higher than at least half of the other cities in the list.

Politico: “These 5 states are the most likely to see legislative chambers flip in November” All five — Arizona, Michigan, Minnesota, New Hampshire, and Pennsylvania — are on our list of priority states. Here’s a quick update on the work we’re doing across these must-win races:
**Flipping chambers in Arizona and New Hampshire.**
In Arizona, Republicans hold just a _two-seat majority_ in both the state House and Senate. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can strengthen the state’s redistricting process.
In New Hampshire, mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted, so the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win majorities in the State House and Senate to prevent Republicans from engaging in mid-cycle partisan gerrymandering.

**Holding chambers in Michigan and Minnesota.**
In Michigan, Republicans are trying to take back the State House and end the Democratic trifecta we helped win in 2022. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission.
In Minnesota, the Democrats hold a trifecta which helped enact Gov. Tim Walz’s bold agenda. Republicans only need to flip _five_ seats to gain control of the State House and block all the amazing progress we’ve seen there this year. (In 2022, _just 321 votes_ flipped control of the State Senate to a one-seat Democratic majority!)
[**Donate to help hold chambers across the country >>**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94518585/503779750/1485360112?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_Headline5StatesRedux_email_20241008-NDRC-Tier1-Headline5StatesRedux-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241008-NDRC-Tier1-Headline5StatesRedux-NOR_&utm_campaign=Headline5StatesRedux&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ0YmM3MjcxLTY0ODUtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=st63k2QlprznYexOiYRql4BitAgaHCZ0-TNbPQJc00s=)
**Doing both in Pennsylvania — flipping the State Senate and holding the House.**
Pennsylvania is currently the _only_ state in the country with a divided legislature (where Democrats hold one legislative chamber and Republicans hold the other), after Democrats flipped the House in 2022.
Earlier this year, States United Action reported that nearly _1 in 3 members of the Pennsylvania House are election deniers_. And when the brave first responders who defended our capitol on January 6th visited the Pennsylvania House, several Republicans _booed and walked out._
Pennsylvanians deserve better than that. If we flip the Senate AND hold the House, another Democratic trifecta will give us a route to redistricting reform.

| | | | | Peter – For those of you not following every detail of my Senate race, I wanted to let you know that tonight I'll be debating my opponent, Mike Rogers, for the first time. As a refresher, despite painting himself as a moderate in the 20 years he was a politician, he has done what so many have unfortunately done before him: said whatever he thinks he needs to say to win this seat. In many cases, that means giving up on portraying himself as a moderate and touting Trump’s extreme positions as an election denier. In other cases, he thinks his 20-year voting record won't matter and he has tried to position himself as more reasonable on things like choice. One thing about debates is that there is a lot of preparation and practice before the actual event. So the last week has been all about "debate prep." It also means there's virtually no time for fundraising. That's fine. It is not my favorite part of the job by any stretch. But it also means I am hoping supporters like you can help fill that gap. It's especially important given the recent outside spending against us and the need to be ready for anything that comes our way after the debate. ** Measure The Vote
------------------------------------------------------------

** Use GOP Datacenter to determine which Republicans
------------------------------------------------------------

** need a nudge on Election Day
------------------------------------------------------------

Overview

Implement a system to track all registered town Republicans who vote during Early Voting or by Absentee Voting. This system will help us create a last-minute list of Republicans who haven’t voted by Election Day.

Where do I get the Data?

The system utilizes data from the GOP Datacenter, which contains information on all registered Republicans in your town. LINK TO VOTE TRACKER (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18Gh2OfP5JWiSKKrYIoonTd4l8KWEmkgTStMYGhg7R8E/edit?usp=sharing) . Enlist the help of your Registrar of Voters or assign an RTC volunteer to access and download the data each night.

What tools to use for tracking the voters

A Google Sheet will be created with the following fields: name, address, phone numbers, and voter ID. Each voter will have a checkable box next to their information for tracking purposes.

What can the volunteers do to make this happen?

During Early Voting until Sunday, November 3rd, volunteers will collect names of Republicans who have voted via a daily report available from the GOP Datacenter.

Each voted Republican will be marked in the sheet’s “voted” column.

How do we use the data to get Republicans out to vote?

On Monday, November 4th, filter the list to show only Republicans who HAVE NOT voted yet. This list and phone numbers will be sent to your Digital Agency (PGS) for an outreach campaign via text and/or robocalls, urging Republicans to vote on Election Day. Graphics and scripts for outreach can be found in the link button below.

Building the GOTV Army?

Recruit 2-3 volunteers to help manage the voter tracking and outreach. Updates should be done each evening with a running tally. Compare the Datacenter report to your master spreadsheet or Google Doc. Mark the voted Republicans and then focus on those who have yet to vote.

Message

Every Republican Counts—Every Republican Votes!

See Google Sheets Sample Below:
View the Google Sheet Template (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18Gh2OfP5JWiSKKrYIoonTd4l8KWEmkgTStMYGhg7R8E/edit?usp=sharing)

** GOTV Tools - Put them to use
------------------------------------------------------------

Graphics make your message stand out. You can use the graphics provided to help voters choose absentee voting if it works best for them. Here are some ideas:

• Text Messaging: Send a graphic and include a link to order a ballot online.

• Postcards: Mail to voters over a certain age, like 75.

• Social Media: Post graphics and messages, share with friends, and go viral.

• RTC Website: Use for illustration of these critical concepts.

• Digital Campaigns: Partner with PGS Marketing to start your campaign.

I’ve created these graphics for your absentee ballot GOTV program. Use the red button below to download high-res versions! Please share any campaigns you create! Send to dominic@dominicforct.us

Download Graphics and Scripts (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1oXW8B9FH-spKxZbjZW7x-t7fNpCgLAYc?usp=share_link)

Stay tuned, and stay hungry. We got this!

body:
Donald Trump delivers on promise to visit Mile High state, announces MAGA rally Friday in Aurora
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Did you know you can add Rocky Mountain Voice to your iPhone or Android home screen so it looks and functions like an app? Check out the instructions below to easily access the dozens of articles we post daily!
_**iPhone or iPad**_ Open the website in Safari, tap the Share icon (square with an arrow), tap Add to Home Screen, name the shortcut, and then tap Add. You can also add a shortcut to your home screen from the Shortcuts app.

_**Android**_ Open the website in Chrome, tap the menu icon (three dots), tap Add to home screen, and then name the shortcut. You can also add a website shortcut to your home screen using Firefox for Android.
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, October 8, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Donald Trump delivers on promise to visit Mile High state, announces MAGA rally Friday in Aurora](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Donald J. Trump is delivering on another promise for Coloradans.
The former President has announced a rally in which he will deliver remarks at 1 p.m. Friday, Oct. 11, at the Gaylord Rockies Resort & Convention Center, 6700 N. Gaylord Rockies Blvd., in Aurora. Trump had repeatedly said he would visit the Front Range community during prior rallies.
“Kamala’s border bloodbath has made every state a border state, leaving Colorado families at the mercy of criminals,” a press release from the Trump-Vance campaign announcing the appearance reads. “The only solution to stop the border crisis is to elect President Trump, who will secure the border, deport dangerous criminals, and Make America Safe Again.”
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[One-year anniversary of Oct. 7 attacks arrives with lasting trauma for Israelis, American Jews](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* One year after the Oct. 7, 2023, terrorist attacks in Israel, survivors and families continue to experience trauma, with many still displaced and struggling to rebuild their lives.
* Many Israelis, particularly in border areas, face ongoing threats, and the situation has led to increased support systems like trauma hotlines and counseling services.

* Fox also noted rising antisemitism in the U.S., particularly on college campuses, where Jewish students feel increasingly unsafe, drawing historical parallels to pre-World War II Europe.

* Despite the trauma, there is a strong sense of resilience and community among Israelis, with people coming together to provide shelter and support for those displaced.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert listens to Western Slope leaders on energy, water and land use](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Bryce and Lisa Casto, sixth-generation ranchers, expressed concerns about the proposed Dolores Monument designation, which could hinder their ability to manage their land and livestock.
* U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert highlighted her commitment to reducing government interference and supporting Colorado's energy, water, and agricultural needs, emphasizing her bipartisan legislative efforts.
* Rural energy and land use challenges were central, with discussions on the impact of regulatory uncertainty and the need for balanced energy strategies that don’t overburden rural communities.
* Water infrastructure was emphasized as crucial for Western Colorado, with federal support needed to sustain projects like the Project 7 Regional Water Supply Program.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[U.S. House Speaker Mike Johnson says one Colorado race could help decide control of Congress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* U.S. Speaker of the House Mike Johnson visited Colorado's 8th Congressional District to support Republican candidate Gabe Evans, describing the race as crucial for control of the U.S. House.
* Johnson believes Evans has a strong chance of winning against Democratic incumbent Yadira Caraveo, citing a potential demographic shift in favor of Republicans, including Hispanic and Latino voters.
* CD8, which is 40% Hispanic, was key to Caraveo's win in 2022, but Evans' personal background, including his grandfather’s Mexican heritage and his military service, is expected to resonate with voters.
* Evans has made border security a central issue, while Caraveo focuses on abortion rights; both candidates will debate on October 18. While Caraveo leads in fundraising, Johnson emphasized Evans' strong qualifications, predicting more financial support for his campaign.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Supreme Court docket includes ghost guns, a capital case and transgender rights](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX BUSINESS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The U.S. Supreme Court has begun its new term, with significant cases on ghost guns, a death sentence, and transgender rights on the docket.
* The court will hear a case challenging the Biden administration’s regulations on ghost guns, which are untraceable firearms, as gun rights groups argue the rules overstep legal bounds.
* A rare death penalty case will be reviewed, where even Oklahoma’s attorney general seeks to overturn Richard Glossip’s conviction due to prosecutorial mistakes.
* The court is also set to take up a high-profile case on transgender rights, focusing on a Tennessee law that restricts gender-affirming care for minors, with arguments likely in December.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Donald Trump gets polling boost among women likely to decide election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEWSWEEK](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Donald Trump is gaining support among white women without college degrees, a critical demographic expected to influence the outcome of the 2024 election. According to a PBS News/NPR/Marist poll, Trump leads Vice President Kamala Harris by 13 points in this group, a demographic that could be decisive in swing states like Michigan, Wisconsin, and Pennsylvania.
* Suburban women, who were pivotal in Biden's 2020 victory, are currently focused on economic issues, with 72% of them listing the economy as a top priority, but many believe Harris lacks solutions.
* Harris is concentrating her campaign on issues important to women, including reproductive rights, health, and inflation, but her lead in key swing states is slim, with margins of only 0.5 to 2 points. The economy and abortion are emerging as central issues for suburban women, a vital demographic in this election.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Wallison: The case for an Israeli attack on Iran’s nuclear facilities](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY PETER J WALLISON, [PETERJWALLISON.SUBSTACK.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Most of the discussion about how Israel should respond to the latest Iranian missile attack fails to consider that Iran is not an ordinary aggressor country, driven by a desire to dominate its neighbors or its region._ _
__Instead, Iran is a “theocratic republic,” headed by a Shi’ite religious figure, appointed for life, who makes all important governmental decisions. As such, the country cannot be appeased by any Israeli effort to reach an accommodation; Iran’s hostility to the very existence of Israel is fundamental to its current system of government._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Billington& Koeppen: Hunting is an honored tradition that preserves heritage](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY CARLY BILLINGTON & CHRISTINE KOEPPEN, [THE FENCE POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Throughout history, hunting has served as a vital part of our nation’s heritage and culture. It embodies the rural community and lifestyle, with many hunters describing a deep connection to the land and reverence for wildlife. Each year, sportsmen invest significant time immersing themselves in nature to understand wildlife behavior, and actively participate in ongoing conservation efforts. Now this time-honored way of life is being threatened in Colorado by Proposition 127 — a proposed ban on hunting mountain lions, bobcats or lynx._
_Colorado rancher and hunting activist Christine Koeppen is aiming to break stereotypes and raise awareness on the hunting and fur pelt ban being proposed on the ballots in November, and why it’s so much bigger than just the state of Colorado._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Hillman: Poor roadway conditions make for undriveable Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MARK HILLMAN, [THE GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Colorado highways are among the worst in the nation. That’s hardly news to anyone who travels across our state._
_Only two states report a larger share of interstate highways in poorer condition than Colorado. Less-traveled highways in our state are even worse._
_In 2021, the Democrat-controlled Legislature passed a $5.4 billion package of new “fees” — including a yearly increase in fuel taxes and that irritating 29-cent charge Coloradans pay on every Amazon order — supposedly to boost the transportation budget._ [READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

Trump is delivering on another promise for Coloradans. The former President has announced a rally in which he will deliver remarks at 1 p.m. Friday, Oct. 11, at the Gaylord Rockies Resort & Convention Center, 6700 N. Gaylord Rockies Blvd., in Aurora. Trump had repeatedly said he would visit the Front Range community during prior rallies. “Kamala’s border bloodbath has made every state a border state, leaving Colorado families at the mercy of criminals,” a press release from the Trump-Vance campaign announcing the appearance reads. “The only solution to stop the border crisis is to elect President Trump, who will secure the border, deport dangerous criminals, and Make America Safe Again.” | One year after the Oct. 7, 2023, terrorist attacks in Israel, survivors and families continue to experience trauma, with many still displaced and struggling to rebuild their lives. Many Israelis, particularly in border areas, face ongoing threats, and the situation has led to increased support systems like trauma hotlines and counseling services. Fox also noted rising antisemitism in the U.S., particularly on college campuses, where Jewish students feel increasingly unsafe, drawing historical parallels to pre-World War II Europe. Despite the trauma, there is a strong sense of resilience and community among Israelis, with people coming together to provide shelter and support for those displaced. | Bryce and Lisa Casto, sixth-generation ranchers, expressed concerns about the proposed Dolores Monument designation, which could hinder their ability to manage their land and livestock. U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert highlighted her commitment to reducing government interference and supporting Colorado's energy, water, and agricultural needs, emphasizing her bipartisan legislative efforts. Rural energy and land use challenges were central, with discussions on the impact of regulatory uncertainty and the need for balanced energy strategies that don’t overburden rural communities. Water infrastructure was emphasized as crucial for Western Colorado, with federal support needed to sustain projects like the Project 7 Regional Water Supply Program. | U.S. Speaker of the House Mike Johnson visited Colorado's 8th Congressional District to support Republican candidate Gabe Evans, describing the race as crucial for control of the U.S. House. Johnson believes Evans has a strong chance of winning against Democratic incumbent Yadira Caraveo, citing a potential demographic shift in favor of Republicans, including Hispanic and Latino voters. CD8, which is 40% Hispanic, was key to Caraveo's win in 2022, but Evans' personal background, including his grandfather’s Mexican heritage and his military service, is expected to resonate with voters. Evans has made border security a central issue, while Caraveo focuses on abortion rights; both candidates will debate on October 18. While Caraveo leads in fundraising, Johnson emphasized Evans' strong qualifications, predicting more financial support for his campaign. | The U.S. Supreme Court has begun its new term, with significant cases on ghost guns, a death sentence, and transgender rights on the docket. A rare death penalty case will be reviewed, where even Oklahoma’s attorney general seeks to overturn Richard Glossip’s conviction due to prosecutorial mistakes. According to a PBS News/NPR/Marist poll, Trump leads Vice President Kamala Harris by 13 points in this group, a demographic that could be decisive in swing states like Michigan, Wisconsin, and Pennsylvania. Suburban women, who were pivotal in Biden's 2020 victory, are currently focused on economic issues, with 72% of them listing the economy as a top priority, but many believe Harris lacks solutions. Harris is concentrating her campaign on issues important to women, including reproductive rights, health, and inflation, but her lead in key swing states is slim, with margins of only 0.5 to 2 points. | | Happy Tuesday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There are only __**28 days**__ until Election Day. I want to take a moment to just say thank you for all the hard work everyone reading this email has helped to put in. Campaigns are not easy, and I look forward to seeing the culmination of all of our hard work on Nov. 5th when we send Tom back to Congress. Thousands of vote-by-mail ballots have been returned already, and the Early Voting period is just under three weeks away. Please consider volunteering to phone bank, knock doors, or make yard signs so we can maintain our momentum, break further ahead, and run up the score before Election Day. This past week, Tom and our campaign team attended in-district events, fundraised ahead of the Q3 close, door knocked and phone banked. Thanks to your help, we out-walked and out-called our opponent's team. Let's double down on our efforts together next week and continue to beat her on the grassroots level. This coming week is a BIG ONE. Tom and his opponent will go head-to-head in the NJ-07 New Jersey Globe Debate. Tom is fired-up, and we hope you will watch and cheer him on! The Debate will be held on **Sunday, October 13th, at 8:00p **streaming live for free on the [New Jersey Globe website.](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=ada1d1b5408c489fbbdca192a4639ad9&_e=EE3TvTZXsQjiLT0aktf1tOLcZTTK2gmMq5hQO4oiVzX13841_E-m7WOCrI1G33Pv-TWhok0WRZmUvSEevu-jIKYN1btJuC9k3LfYFpnuFyn6VS6LcCkLAMBV8zdHjOTi0EFKgenppOUBOpIEABJkQgS1pGHYWdcfx8T09u-ZBQ9e9AlHvYfDivHJ9fZGsZmWfRgOecsrPeYx4yaDShpdrQ%3D%3D) We will send out details for debate watch parties this week and hope to see you there! Our Field Team spent the week organizing volunteers and working with our local campaign partners on the ground. With their help our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts are proving successful. We hosted our usual weekly phone banks, and increased our door-to-door canvassing goal across all six counties. We put up some impressive numbers you can more read about below. This week, our comms team highlighted our [key alliances with labor unions](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=ada1d1b5408c489fbbdca192a4639ad9&_e=EE3TvTZXsQjiLT0aktf1tL_35ulWthUyUukkeu9lAhzDKPtDCylSTf7AR9ljvD0JVlJK5oZPowHo_9o0Sr3yh3nu8Ucd9GaFMistGg8qcLKW5jIM_bNi8cCrc4cLFbTgzM4zbiMwJeo3wd3RvqyY5yA7Sd5ibpfGVutc5lowNnDObR3LtzS_cUhMiURj4dkyvbBpN03BFnyQ3PC__tkKaR7FfZG-J7X56WB61nW7t-RBNItuTbv6JC4oV5n_9swnyL-QM7_XMiPl9YawHqCz2fDuZmndAswjROvpEFq0h8D6m33qor6SOsG9hZKqoK99t5efcNb5sMv53DvkJ-U9r_ZeeY7gnWPYjDWnUKF6HIR1rYJImawX9upsRPqvcFcbHK7AHkwJdHJ0SM4bE8yGZF6eqzzThrKF74XuCVugu9c0OHuyQ751cSCLUvYGlKMQ), announced some brand new endorsements, and boosted law enforcements' [blistering response](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=ada1d1b5408c489fbbdca192a4639ad9&_e=EE3TvTZXsQjiLT0aktf1tOLcZTTK2gmMq5hQO4oiVzV3HsmBkbjJP3iBlYF2TkxkKoOE72S40ud0jV28994_3-tg9DKLwRCL8TomWD6e5h87HzzQM0ynnMiqMKh_WU0w8hVk7VUW0fqdaKB7wBiOalCBN0OV74TwZG0qmuAtxN7Vwx9thxkjVq2jCBuKfgnXpFs7d-NOnGHmnqV9VURzLTyA-LS1_gOCTlSMf1LgxdK1EGn-KQ6PyMqisFu-OayZk0blAbweMXrC9e_NtKxsTpmmw9gjg__aZAqrSsLkXtcEJkiVQA2X3_Qy5BQyqFjv03-2f8-6St_tEwB7Z5dJpPXN1YzBBTekCDNNmyZMU8SrrxkdCTcj4ToS9iaB9FSyfjUb3uyX1JuoA3qZjqj6oklvtSviVe_l3SoIUF1lSXNwnBN0RqsB2sbv2NADfMfvqkC97WVn4rCTrn4pbgDMGQ%3D%3D) to our opponent's misleading television ad. Follow us on social media so you don't miss out on any updates from our comms team! Most vote-by-mail voters should have received their ballots this past week, especially in outstanding counties like Somerset and Union. Please make sure to check your mailbox for your ballot, complete it and send it back by using either a secure dropbox, the U.S. Postal Service, or by delivering it to your county Board of Elections. You can still request a vote-by-mail ballot if you would like until October 29th. | | **✅ Kean Visits FY25 Community Project Funding Site in Mountainside ✅**
---
| | This past week, Tom continued his FY25 Community Project Funding Tour in Mountainside. He met with Mountainside Mayor Paul Mirabelli and other local officials to discuss local law enforcement needs in preparation for the FY25 appropriations process. Tom has requested $63,250 in funding for Mountainside Borough Hall, which would be used to install new security cameras at both the Borough Hall and the fire department, along with a computerized badge access system.
_“With the uptick of crime in our neighborhoods, it is crucial that public safety buildings are updated with modern technology to enhance security measures, improve surveillance capabilities, and ensure the safety of residents, visitors, and staff alike.” _ \- _**Congressman Tom Kean, Jr.**_

clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Happy Tuesday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There are only 28 days until Election Day. I want to take a moment to just say thank you for all the hard work everyone reading this email has helped to put in. Campaigns are not easy, and I look forward to seeing the culmination of all of our hard work on Nov. 5th when we send Tom back to Congress. Thousands of vote-by-mail ballots have been returned already, and the Early Voting period is just under three weeks away. Please consider volunteering to phone bank, knock doors, or make yard signs so we can maintain our momentum, break further ahead, and run up the score before Election Day. This past week, Tom and our campaign team attended in-district events, fundraised ahead of the Q3 close, door knocked and phone banked. Thanks to your help, we out-walked and out-called our opponent's team. Let's double down on our efforts together next week and continue to beat her on the grassroots level. This coming week is a BIG ONE. Tom and his opponent will go head-to-head in the NJ-07 New Jersey Globe Debate. Tom is fired-up, and we hope you will watch and cheer him on! The Debate will be held on Sunday, October 13th, at 8:00p streaming live for free on the We will send out details for debate watch parties this week and hope to see you there! Our Field Team spent the week organizing volunteers and working with our local campaign partners on the ground. With their help our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts are proving successful. We hosted our usual weekly phone banks, and increased our door-to-door canvassing goal across all six counties. We put up some impressive numbers you can more read about below. This week, our comms team highlighted our , announced some brand new endorsements, and boosted law enforcements' to our opponent's misleading television ad. Follow us on social media so you don't miss out on any updates from our comms team! Most vote-by-mail voters should have received their ballots this past week, especially in outstanding counties like Somerset and Union. Please make sure to check your mailbox for your ballot, complete it and send it back by using either a secure dropbox, the U.S. Postal Service, or by delivering it to your county Board of Elections. You can still request a vote-by-mail ballot if you would like until October 29th. You can find more information on all ways to vote and participate by visiting our . Please make sure to complete your ballot and return it before November 5th. Questions? . Are you ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? To get involved,. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! P.S.: Lawn signs are moving fast, to request a Kean for Congress lawn sign now while you can! | | | | | | | ✅ Kean Visits FY25 Community Project Funding Site in Mountainside ✅ | | This past week, Tom continued his FY25 Community Project Funding Tour in Mountainside. He met with Mountainside Mayor Paul Mirabelli and other local officials to discuss local law enforcement needs in preparation for the FY25 appropriations process. Tom has requested $63,250 in funding for Mountainside Borough Hall, which would be used to install new security cameras at both the Borough Hall and the fire department, along with a computerized badge access system. “With the uptick of crime in our neighborhoods, it is crucial that public safety buildings are updated with modern technology to enhance security measures, improve surveillance capabilities, and ensure the safety of residents, visitors, and staff alike.” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | Tom made stops in New Providence to door knock and attend the New Providence PBA Car Show, Mendham Borough to attend the Mayor's Fall Festival, Watchung to judge the Annual Chili Contest, Bernards to attend the Fall Festival, as well as stops for community events in Springfield, Scotch Plains, and Somerville! Did you see see him at any stops? Send any pictures to our mailto:Info@TomKean.com "Info@TomKean.com". Tom will continue to be all across the district this week speaking with voters and attending events. The Field Team put our lawn sign blitz plan into motion, scheduled upcoming door launches, and activated volunteers. They prepped walk lists for local candidates, and also prepared significant resources for the upcoming labor walks we have. If you or anyone you know is interested in stepping up to assist, please use the volunteer sign up link below to join the team. Our door knocking program covered towns like Bedminster , Bridgewater , Bernards , Bernardsville , Watchung , Warren Twp. , Green Brook, Hackettstown, Phillipsburg, Lopatcong, Pohatcong, Mansfield, newton, Washington Borough, Sparta, Byram, Hopatcong, Flemington, High Bridge, Readington, Westfield, Berkeley Heights, Long Hill, Springfield, Mountainside, and New Providence! I would like to give a special shoutout to the Somerset County Federation of Republican Women, who joined us this past week and assemble over 700 signs for Tom! The lawn signs are moving fast, and their help ensures we have a stockpile of the infrastructure needed to get signs all across NJ-07. We have a number of scheduled launches in the coming weeks, including with our partners in labor. We hope to see you there. Our weekly door goal is once again increasing significantly next week, and we must make sure we are doing everything we can to reach the voters we need to. Kean for Congress continued our phone banking efforts with four organized phone banks this week - Union, Hunterdon, Warren and Somerset. This week we were able to call over 20,000 voters across all six counties. This was our best week on phones yet. The phone banks and the work of our remote callers is producing real results and valuable voter contacts, as well as chasing outstanding vote-by-mail ballots to be returned. We also sent out over 116,000 text messages to residents and voters. We honed in on GOP voters who have yet to return their ballots, as well as some general GOTV messaging. Did you get a text? We have a minimum of two to three phone banks a week that you can join from now until Election Day! Our county organizations are launching their vote-by-mail chase efforts on phones this week. We will continue our texting banks - an easy way to get involved - to continue to put up points on the board. Call for Volunteers!! The Kean for Congress team will have a significant door launch efforts in the coming weeks. Join Team Kean and local candidates as we knock on key swing-voter doors. Want to join us? Use the SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER button below and details will be provided. Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 🚨 Endorsement Alerts 🚨 | | | | | | | Kean for Congress announced another MAJOR law enforcement endorsement this week: The National Troopers Coalition 🚔 👮🏽, as well as an endorsement from Former Secretary of State Mike Pompeo. As the only pro-law enforcement candidate in the race, Tom has secured over millions in federal funding for first responder and law enforcement initiatives in NJ07. No matter what you hear from our opponent, there is only one candidate that law enforcement supports: Tom Kean, Jr. New Jersey's Law Enforcement is Backing Kean: ✅ Fraternal Order of Police ✅ Policemen's Benevolent Association ✅ State Troopers Fraternal Association ✅ National Association of Police Organizations ✅ National Troopers Coalition Follow our using this link for more endorsements to be announced in the coming days! | | | | | 🚨 Opponent Exposed! 🚨 | | This week, and the reported on Altman's hot-mic moment saying she "isn't super worried" about men in women's locker room.
