# [What you can do with 28 days until the election](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=149670502&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ5NjcwNTAyLCJpYXQiOjE3MjgzOTAxNTEsImV4cCI6MTczMDk4MjE1MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.Pv-Z2-dsPyMAOQiTkgFTbsoBwSP7YhhlFLOAT8syS-Y)
### In order: Vote. Text your friends and get them to vote. Donate.
| | [Ben Samuels](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---
| Oct 8
---
| [](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---
---
| | | [](https://substack..wa2Y_3ccCB6OhkUgZ_fJTnlNiPn52KA_veZH4ZydaRE?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/bensamuels/p/how-you-can-make-a-difference-in-the-last-month-of-the-election?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---
With the election coming up, I've been getting asked these two questions a lot:
1. Who is going to win? (My answer: I think Kamala Harris will win, but it'll be close, and I wouldn't bet my house on it.)
2. What can I do to get involved?

If you want to channel that nervous pre-election energy, here's what you can be doing. In order from least important (but still important) to most important:
1. **Donate to candidates and causes where your support will have the biggest impact.** [Here's a link you can use to make those donations](https://substack.com/redirect/b49f2a4d-8e5a-444e-92d6-b47278318e58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), if you feel so inclined.1 More info about each of them below.
2. **Text friends and family, and encourage them to vote.** Phone banking and canvassing helps, certainly, but [reaching out to people you know is ](https://substack.com/redirect/edab590a-3e3f-4be3-87c4-70aba47eba0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[by far](https://substack.com/redirect/edab590a-3e3f-4be3-87c4-70aba47eba0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ the most effective thing you can personally do to increase turnout](https://substack.com/redirect/edab590a-3e3f-4be3-87c4-70aba47eba0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
3. **Vote!** If at all possible, vote early, and get your friends/family to vote early with you, especially if they're younger: [young voters--a critical part of the Democratic coalition--are far less likely to vote when there's bad weather on election day](https://substack.com/redirect/8dd9788c-e289-4722-a599-b9eb0b7f7ecd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Voting early gets out ahead of that.

[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTQ5NjcwNTAyLCJzIjoyNDQwMzk4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzI4MzkwMTUxLCJleHAiOjE3MzA5ODIxNTEsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.BeSDpTVuZiBJ-YoYlrIZ7wb0sx4W9yrowoECouq52Gw?)
## 1\. Where to donate your money
_[Here's a link to donate to races that really matter](https://substack.com/redirect/b49f2a4d-8e5a-444e-92d6-b47278318e58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and where your money can have a real impact. An up-front caveat: there is no perfect giving strategy. Information is imperfect and asymmetrical; our priorities vary. I've tried to select races that matter most for Democrats locally and nationally, but there are plenty of other important races out there too._
Here are candidates and causes worth supporting. Below, I'll tell you why.
* U.S. House candidates
* [Rebecca Cooke](https://substack.com/redirect/96dd0935-6a78-4b74-b645-efea42c7a42c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (Wisconsin-03)
* [Will Rollins](https://substack.com/redirect/3ace77f2-608b-4bd8-a0fb-60c30c78ac1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (California-41)
* [Amish Shah](https://substack.com/redirect/7226482e-19bc-43ec-9bab-2329bc2b7a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (Arizona-01)
* [Tony Vargas](https://substack.com/redirect/9bb68442-4617-4271-b11e-ba99ff22f714?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (Nebraska-02)
* [George Whitesides](https://substack.com/redirect/d7ea5bcd-0059-4f1a-b71d-dad35e896bd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (California-27)
* U.S. Senate candidates
* [Dan Osborn](https://substack.com/redirect/173144de-5e18-49b1-be99-551fe4984054?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (Nebraska)
* Organizations and causes
* [Missourians for Constitutional Freedom](https://substack.com/redirect/925b3260-24b8-4ec4-9c81-5eac7b2a4d11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (abortion access in Missouri)
* [WelcomePAC](https://substack.com/redirect/86228b86-a758-4609-ba71-e5ab79566346?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/b49f2a4d-8e5a-444e-92d6-b47278318e58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
#### U.S. House candidates
Right now, on the prediction markets, Kamala Harris has a [53% chance of winning](https://substack.com/redirect/c404e26b-01d2-49ee-af17-aac9978ba4dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The Democrats have a [68% chance of winning back the House](https://substack.com/redirect/72587091-e1ce-4997-840e-970ff6212202?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This means that there are three realistic2 outcomes:
1. Harris wins. Strong Democratic U.S. House candidates help drive turnout, and a Democratic majority gives her some chance to legislate.
2. Harris loses, and Democrats win back the U.S. House. Based on prediction markets today, there is an implied 15% chance that this happens.
3. Harris loses, and Republicans hold the U.S. House. Trump winning is a terrible outcome, but if he wins _and_ Republicans control the House, his ability to legislate is unchecked.

Even if Harris loses, **we must win back the House.** Supporting the strongest candidates in the toughest races is a great way to do that.
All five of the House candidates on my list are challengers. Why? [It is much harder to raise money as a challenger than as an incumbent](https://substack.com/redirect/5b6990aa-1cfd-420b-8e95-fe4b2ff8e665?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Each one is running in a swing seat, and each one has polling [within](https://substack.com/redirect/c119243c-b062-40c6-bb21-3fc01fc54a2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [the](https://substack.com/redirect/6c228117-72fc-4bc1-9644-5872e3d33353?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [margin](https://substack.com/redirect/7f5a391c-8be2-427a-9f92-49c1f159481d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [of](https://substack.com/redirect/a496ed07-ae77-49f1-9f17-3da906beadec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [error](https://substack.com/redirect/1036953f-c5f3-4d02-8e85-c16040fe8b15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
If Democrats are going to win the House, it will be because candidates like these five--and others that groups like [WelcomePAC](https://substack.com/redirect/86228b86-a758-4609-ba71-e5ab79566346?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)3 are supporting--are grinding out tough wins in purple districts.
#### Dan Osborn for Senate in Nebraska
One of the most intriguing candidates this cycle is [Dan Osborn](https://substack.com/redirect/173144de-5e18-49b1-be99-551fe4984054?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an independent running in Nebraska. (There is no Democrat running for this seat; it's independent Dan Osborn vs. Republican incumbent Deb Fischer.) The race has no business being this competitive, and yet _[FiveThirtyEight](https://substack.com/redirect/73daf186-058b-4a3f-bd52-d78df3b3c8e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ says it's the tightest Senate race in the whole country](https://substack.com/redirect/73daf186-058b-4a3f-bd52-d78df3b3c8e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
He's running a great campaign against an [unpopular Republican incumbent](https://substack.com/redirect/7f1b7138-e1c9-4cec-b054-f089ac6bbb7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Osborn's race is still a steep uphill climb,4 but unlike others running against Republicans across the country, he isn't raising $100s of millions. So a dollar goes a lot further.
Tony Vargas, who I noted above, is also in Nebraska. So why so many Nebraskans?
1. As you may have seen in the news recently, Nebraska is unusual in how it [allocates its electoral votes](https://substack.com/redirect/9223f182-cd96-4a66-862d-79b653c967ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), doing so by Congressional district and not by whoever wins statewide. And there is a [very plausible scenario where the one electoral vote from Nebraska-02](https://substack.com/redirect/2b45f5aa-cad9-4f1a-a5e3-9e48974870fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (around Omaha) is the difference-maker for Harris.
2. Harris, Osborn, and Vargas all face tough races there. But a rising tide lifts all ships: if Vargas does well, for instance, it helps Osborn and Harris.5

[Donate to these candidates](https://substack.com/redirect/b49f2a4d-8e5a-444e-92d6-b47278318e58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
#### You don't need to support other U.S. Senate candidates (anymore)
To the extent that you've been hit with political solicitations--and I imagine that you have been--I bet most of them are coming either from the Harris campaign or from the U.S. Senate races. Those races have raised, and are spending, huge amounts of money. Here's an [Axios chart from a few months ago](https://substack.com/redirect/fb9fbeb9-7f16-4312-af76-e5dfd56e1e01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3979f9e1-05cc-4d08-9801-ce0a30b268ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I know we're all used to politics being out-of-hand expensive, but this is a astounding amount of money. In Montana, spending has ballooned since Axios wrote this article, and [spending will exceed $250 ](https://substack.com/redirect/28f6f18d-2632-404f-9e09-74b59aacfecd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[per person](https://substack.com/redirect/28f6f18d-2632-404f-9e09-74b59aacfecd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ in the state](https://substack.com/redirect/28f6f18d-2632-404f-9e09-74b59aacfecd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).6 In Nevada, spending in its Senate race will end up approaching $50 per person.7
There are [diminishing returns in political advertising](https://substack.com/redirect/36bff2f7-7a90-42ba-8a08-be8cfc7ca0e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). These races are _way_ past that point.
#### Missourians for Constitutional Freedom and WelcomePAC
Finally, two organizations worthy of support:
1. I've [written about abortion access in Missouri](https://substack.com/redirect/80045563-139f-4153-81ae-6016e3f37155?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It's important, and if it passes in a state as Republican as Missouri, it creates a roadmap to pass it in the rest of the country. A robust turnout on this issue will help other Democrats running in competitive state legislative races, like State Senate candidate [Joe Pereles](https://substack.com/redirect/e76eb6cd-496f-4ec3-a9b3-2dd678213557?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
2. [WelcomePAC](https://substack.com/redirect/86228b86-a758-4609-ba71-e5ab79566346?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) focuses on the toughest winnable U.S. House races by supporting strong candidates and building a big tent. Whether their slate of candidates wins will be a difference-maker if the Democrats are to win back a majority in the House.

[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/b49f2a4d-8e5a-444e-92d6-b47278318e58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## 2\. Text your friends and family
[According to one study](https://substack.com/redirect/3013db98-0591-494b-9b4e-b8405c00a2c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the impact of texting your friends and encouraging them to vote is staggeringly high: **friends you text and encourage to vote are 8.3% (!) more likely to do so**.8
I'm all for creative get-out-the-vote strategies.9 But texting your friends regardless of where they live--but in particular, your friends who live in swing states--is simple, and it's the highest-impact thing you can individually do.
Not sure who you know in a swing state? Here's a cheat sheet of every area code in every swing state. Take five minutes to search through your contacts; you can look people up by their area code, and you can see if you know anyone there:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/76da8d2c-3063-4aee-a7db-f259b2d70b31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
By the way, the benefits of reaching out to friends goes way beyond voting:
* "Reaching out to friends...--particularly with those we haven't spoken to in a while--can have a larger positive impact than we might think." ([Source](https://substack.com/redirect/1eb911d9-de52-45d6-b30f-e2e37ade9fde?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
* "In a series of studies, including those involving students and adults, senders underestimated how much the communication meant to the recipient." ([Source](https://substack.com/redirect/bb1b1d30-a9fc-4065-bbec-d103dec351a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))

By texting friends and encouraging them to vote, you aren't only being a good citizen. **You 're also being a good friend! **
## 3\. Vote!
Finally: you should **vote early**. In Missouri, [early voting begins on October 22](https://substack.com/redirect/99982602-3a1e-4575-a781-04d977260b60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). You can also [check your voter registration status and see your ballot on the Secretary of State website](https://substack.com/redirect/38a93efa-ebe3-44dd-be93-4240ff8b989c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
If you live elsewhere in the country, the [National Association of Secretaries of State will help you check your voter registration](https://substack.com/redirect/4ea9ef69-0840-4d0c-bd56-af6df7ed3b87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
You, your friends, and your family--and especially any young people you know--should make a point of voting early. Why?
* [People are less likely to vote when it rains](https://substack.com/redirect/8dd9788c-e289-4722-a599-b9eb0b7f7ecd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).10 For every half-inch of rain, turnout declines by 1.2%. From the same study: "young voters are up to six times more susceptible to bad weather." Six times! **If there 's a half-inch of rain on election day, youth turnout could decrease by as much as 7.2%.** Democrats need young voters to turn out if Harris is going to win; we should hope for election-day sun.11
* [When it's colder, people vote less](https://substack.com/redirect/c39fa832-9644-4961-b422-822867e071ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Specifically, every temperature increase of 2°F increases voter turnout by 0.16%.12

Obviously, voting early is a hedge against being sick on election day too. For all that people focus on messaging and turnout, it is remarkable how much these sorts of exogenous things matter.13
And if you're in Missouri, remember to:
* **[Vote NO on Amendment 2](https://substack.com/redirect/1d746fd2-a9e4-4602-91de-59ea8f35a526?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. Mobile sports gambling is dangerous, and Missourians should vote against it.
* **[Vote YES on Amendment 3](https://substack.com/redirect/80045563-139f-4153-81ae-6016e3f37155?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and enshrine abortion access and reproductive healthcare in Missouri's constitution.
* **[Vote NO on Amendment 7](https://substack.com/redirect/cfaa6c11-003f-487e-8b58-da4fdea26c32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , which does nothing to actually make our elections safer but does make common-sense democracy reform marginally harder.

[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTQ5NjcwNTAyLCJzIjoyNDQwMzk4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzI4MzkwMTUxLCJleHAiOjE3MzA5ODIxNTEsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.BeSDpTVuZiBJ-YoYlrIZ7wb0sx4W9yrowoECouq52Gw?)
## The election is almost here
We're in the home stretch of this election. If you're feeling anxious about this--I am and most people I know are--do something about it!
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/b49f2a4d-8e5a-444e-92d6-b47278318e58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
1
Full disclosure: I think ActBlue is pretty terrible. They take a [much larger fee than they should](https://substack.com/redirect/bb54d2f4-703a-4c77-8890-f4946f8d5918?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); they're [cavalier with how your data gets shared](https://substack.com/redirect/f1c9fed9-f4cb-4d5c-8c00-d42cf0f76c1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (which I've been both the victim of and, as a candidate and since, the beneficiary of); they don't even work that well relative to other payment platforms. You should _never_ make the voluntary donation to ActBlue that they solicit. But we're close to an election, and it's the fastest way to give.
When I give via ActBlue, I do so using a so-called "burner" email address and phone number--that keeps me from getting hit with endless spam in the future. Feel free to do the same. [Here's a service I use sometimes](https://substack.com/redirect/82609522-3960-470f-9b34-daf2d4056474?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) when I need a temporary, one-time email address; here's one I've used for [temporary, one-time phone numbers](https://substack.com/redirect/299289cc-824a-4174-8126-ab838b0934fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
You _are_ required to share some accurate personal information: your name, occupation, and address. But that's it.
I've also set up the link in a way where a) you can customize how much you give each candidate, and b) the campaigns won't get your email addresses, unless you opt in.
2
A fourth theoretically possible outcome--Harris wins and Republicans hold the House--is very unlikely.
3
Full disclosure: I do some work for WelcomePAC. But this email isn't in coordination with them (and in fact, their candidates aren't the same as the ones on my list); my encouraging you to support them is because I think they're well positioned to help Democrats win some of the toughest House races in the country.
4
There are shades of the [2014 U.S. Senate race in Kansas](https://substack.com/redirect/83e92e8d-6d1d-4f05-a653-92118ea6318c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in this race, hopefully with a different outcome.
5
Same thing is true with Cooke in Wisconsin and Shah in Arizona: if they can turn out lower-propensity voters, that's good for Harris too.
6
In an election, unfortunately, that [isn't shaping up to be particularly close](https://substack.com/redirect/4bc1fdea-9664-4119-9b1e-70850e1c5991?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It's an outrageous sum of money for such a small state; with the amount they're spending, [they could literally buy groceries for every single household in the state](https://substack.com/redirect/5437e3b3-3a11-4014-adb1-754267fc7d79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for close to a month. (Based on an [average household size of 2.4 people](https://substack.com/redirect/02f7eaa2-f3b6-4423-a850-5ee46ba8f7c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)
7
In an election, fortunately, that [isn't shaping up to be particularly close](https://substack.com/redirect/b97f96d1-e7ba-4c37-a532-0535c9c803f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
8
Two caveats to this:
* Some of this was measured during the COVID-19 pandemic, when perhaps digital communication had a larger impact.
* I haven't seen this study replicated elsewhere.

With all that said: even if the impact is a fraction of this 8.3% figure, it's still hugely important.
9
Take, for instance, this text I got on Friday (below). And yes, this is _still_ less effective than texting your friends and family to get them to vote. ([Coconut Brat PAC](https://substack.com/redirect/b7af0c03-ce2f-47fc-8296-2714ccc8a0dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), by the way, does appear to be a real group.)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0f931af3-7b3d-407b-99cf-bf4027b186c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
10
[Like Newman](https://substack.com/redirect/c703237d-7fd2-47f4-98d9-46bce2921e64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
11
"It should be sunny more" is not a formal policy position. Maybe it should be.
12
For context: [Georgia was decided by 0.24% in 2020](https://substack.com/redirect/1be32004-e58b-4d5d-8826-00fd02ab8e21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Lauren Boebert [won reelection in Colorado by 0.17% in 2022](https://substack.com/redirect/e2ae6ec0-5768-4db7-8a8e-cb247d8548e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). So yes, those margins absolutely matter.
13
Case in point: if in Jacksonville, Florida on November 7, 2000 at noon it had been 80°--[rather than 78°](https://substack.com/redirect/34992935-114b-420b-abed-99701820b4af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--[Al Gore may very well have been President of the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/f5e40c0c-6fbe-44d6-b3f0-76b01ef97d0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), at least according to one study.

When it starts, I'll do my best to make the case for why I am the right choice for the people of Michigan to fight middle class families, for higher wages and lower drug prices, and to ensure women have access to the reproductive health care they need. And while I wish everyone in Michigan would watch the debate and use what they see to inform their decisions, I am not naive. People have families to care for, work to do, and others are totally sick of politics. But we still need to reach those people. I intend to do my job tonight for those who are tuning in. But in order to reach those who won’t be watching, I need your help. And because these debates can tend to be such important inflection points for campaigns like ours, there's no better or more important time to ask. Don't make the mistake of waiting until it is too late. Stock up now on these survival food kits while you can.

#### Good Morning Republicans,

**1 Proverbs 19:21** _You can make many plans, but the LORD's purpose will prevail_

There are quite a few adages on "planning" with the Bible giving us verse after verse on plans.
**Jeremiah 29:11 **"For I know the plans I have for you," says the Lord. They are plans for good and not for disaster..."
**Proverbs 15:26 **"The Lord detests evil plans, but he delights in pure words"
**Psalms 138:8 **"The Lord will work out his plans for my life..."

Others notable phrases...
"Planning is bringing the future into the present: Planning allows you to do something about the future now."
"Failing to plan is planning to fail." - Benjamin Franklin
"It takes as much energy to wish as it does to plan" - Eleanor Roosevelt
"Plan your work for today and every day, then work your plan" - Margaret Thatcher
"Good planning without good working is nothing" - Dwight D. Eisenhower

We have a Political Plan that has been a resounding success so far
#1 **County Development** – The NEGOP believes in strong county organizations and will help to further strengthen these organizations so we can elect Republicans at all tiers of government.
#2 **Education** \- A primary local focus on the elections surrounding the 244 school boards across Nebraska coupled with a statewide focus on the four State Board of Education and four UNL Board of Regents positions.
#3 **Targeted Legislative Districts** Combined campaign efforts for legislative districts, and local races will have the opportunity to connect our party to voters at numerous events and meetings. Tandem mailers and volunteer door knocking will enable candidates to maximize their efforts in both rural and urban races.
* Holding 7 seats held by incumbent Republican state senators
* Securing 8 seats held by termed out Republican state senators
* Securing 6 seats from termed out Democrat state senators
* Flipping 4 seats from incumbent Democrat state senators
* Electing 12 new Republican state senators in open legislative seats

However, our principles...the **Party Platform** HAS to be the guiding documents we use to connect the party to volunteers, volunteers to voters, voters to candidates, candidates to good legislation or individual actions as an elected representative. _**All this activity NEEDS people and planning!**_

As a balance to all the aforementioned adages on planning, we should continue to pray daily that the Lord's plan for our country, our state, our party, is glorified.

God's will is unavoidable, but we are still tasked to walk a path.
* * *
We have been working diligently to bring fruition to the 2024 Political and Legislative Vision and our ability for success in November. In many of my "Coffee" emails, I've tried to convey the national presence we now have in the Republican Party of Nebraska. We have political credibility which is never more apparent by all the relationships we've built.

We are at a crossroads of time and preparation. What I have seen from all facets of our party is a huge increase of voter engagement. Many different organizations, coalitions, county GOP's, and the state party are focused on connecting voters to candidates...to furthering our principles within the community.

I believe that out of all the dust settling from the past two years, the level of stability to the party has opened the doors to greater engagement. Humble leaders, who strive to make a difference in their community, just needed the opportunity to shine.

This effort must persist through November 5th. The early ballot voting has begun and the only sure way to know if a ballot is being returned or if a voter has a "plan" to vote (there's that word again - plan) is by CONTACTING them.

Our voter engagement app - **Numinar** has easy to use features including door knocking, texting, phone bank, and note keeping. We have three trained leaders, one in each Congressional District to assist volunteers. Reach out to [data@ne.gop](mailto:data@ne.gop) to learn more.

There are national conservative leaders like Turning Point Action that has an intuitive app that connects to your contacts list as well as the voter registration files. [https://www.tpaction.com/app](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=ce96c6943a&e=25844e23a8) [](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=1975868bfa&e=25844e23a8)
Several Counties have created **FULL slate cards** to showcase conservative candidates to their constituents. The counties will be mailing the slate cards, but an effective cost saving measure is to walk these cards through the neighborhoods. [](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=742cb94fe2&e=25844e23a8)
**There are _Days of Action_ like the one planned for _LD27 Candidate - Dawn Liphardt_ _THIS SATURDAY, MAY 12th @ 9am_** [](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=0193ad8d28&e=25844e23a8)
**Many candidates utilizing the digital messaging (SEE BELOW) with commercials, testimonials, and endorsements.**

We have so many candidates that NEED your support.

However, even more so...YOU have a town, a state, a country that NEEDS your support. Our LOCAL elections will be won by whichever party has the GREATER will to do the work of building relationships at the door.

We have the right message and we have the common sense values. We have a party that is built on honoring the constitution and defending our platform.

However...
This election is about effort, not social media posts.
This election is about a phone call, not retweets.
This election is about a text, not a post with 100 responses to each other by a handful of people.
This election is about an email or postcard to a low propensity voter

This election is about walking through YOUR neighborhood, putting your fears and anxieties away, to sacrifice everything OR you will LOSE everything. Walking the neighborhood and knowing that there are Republican ballots that will end up in the hands of our OPPOSITION or a voice never heard as it gets tossed in the trash, if we don't get to them first.

This is about gaining MORE Republican voters by doing **Voter Registration drives** because a voter is **4 times more likely** to go and vote if they've signed UP to vote within the 30 days before an election!

The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings,

# ▶️: The Divide of Fear

Peter- did you know that my opponent is using fear-based tactics to divide us, instead of focusing on the real issues that matter?
[**Please watch the video below to understand the dangers of fear-based politics and why it's time for real solutions that benefit our communities:**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=72503f8a24&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=5ea7d620ca&e=a2a46ff12c)
|
As Election Day approaches, I want to speak directly about the tactics being used by my opponent.
My opponent, Morgan Luttrell, continues to focus on one issue: the border. It’s a tired approach, filled with scare tactics and misinformation aimed at driving voters through fear.
But I ask you: why aren’t we focusing on the issues that matter most to our families and communities? Why not work together to restore the rights of every individual in America?
[**This is where I stand apart.** ](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=4181b68c8b&e=a2a46ff12c)
Let’s talk facts. We had a bipartisan border bill that Senate Republicans rejected. As your representative, I will vote YES to secure our borders responsibly and effectively.
I’m not a career politician; I’m one of you, ready to fight for the change we deserve.
This election is about more than just the border. It’s about healthcare, education, and standing up for our communities. However, rather than uniting us, my opponent sows division—turning neighbors against each other.
**Don't let fear dictate your vote.**
[**Peter - When we unite and fight for what’s right, we win. Contribute today and help us safeguard this essential promise.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=e2a73537a0&e=a2a46ff12c)

| Peter, I don’t think I need to tell you this. I think every American with common sense already knows it: this is the most consequential election of our lifetime. So much is at stake and the 2024 Election is FOUR WEEKS away. The economy is flailing, the border is in crisis, and while conflicts break out across the globe, our leadership in the White House is completely absent. Here in New Jersey, businesses are struggling and major corporations are leaving–and taking their jobs with them. Sadly, this is what we can expect when Leftwing lunatics run our country and our state. I wanted to protect people because I believe everyone has a right to safety, dignity, and justice. We have the chance to chart a new way forward -- not as members of any one party or faction, but as Americans. All of that is true.

**[But after 13 months on the campaign trail — I wanted to share with you a bit of my story, and how I know that Mike Rogers is a man worthy of your support. ](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=0a70e169484947ea8eee14caa6b5cf38&_e=QMjIEC5-lBQsnS9VWUeDrP_QFn0OhYQSFS9No4zqg9GnB_eusRdKxQTz8uq5DO-hbflQ_1wH8nF8zq2HVuDyEhES1AwLVCzAg9mcVSV4PD4jIUfXPUZIxREmlpABdfVvTsEIT1LvMz8uskKyVz1bG5LV_VOxnp4LQ-nMkdEXXb3KaAngIxCR0sGv2tjwZvpIiblhvC734-DA9Mbhy5YitbGn_eeQE1lqXPhHQFJwKYkY5zWlrx2IKxEOGhijwwqMWX5P1_wqkkdj3CWUEApBsiywV_sdiFp_mHd_BJSy_CFdJ9Jq3wbKdd9c9laV8ktGcYnzHbGyYmIOkyTamGHY3vNu04GCfQ-zMeO9OSQNvMfGLdhmOE5q90lxwrNAEWj8lb_LNgYGWHpr53J9g_o04Q6JTcHXthgYWaXKL1JT_0rIyc5f2p54JPCY_1dqZkjaOuB94NgCDI5ZPnwIBGk3ada0iqgREO0RwCUNkrlkrkQ%3D)**

I was deployed to Iraq in the height of the conflict in the Middle East while working for the Department of Defense.

Here’s a picture of me from back then:

[](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=0a70e169484947ea8eee14caa6b5cf38&_e=QMjIEC5-lBQsnS9VWUeDrP_QFn0OhYQSFS9No4zqg9GnB_eusRdKxQTz8uq5DO-hbflQ_1wH8nF8zq2HVuDyEhES1AwLVCzAg9mcVSV4PD4jIUfXPUZIxREmlpABdfVvTsEIT1LvMz8uskKyVz1bG5LV_VOxnp4LQ-nMkdEXXb3KaAngIxCR0sGv2tjwZvpIiblhvC734-DA9Mbhy5YitbGn_eeQE1lqXPhHQFJwKYkY5zWlrx2IKxEOGhijwwqMWX5P1_wqkkdj3CWUEApBsiywV_sdiFp_mHd_BJSy_CFdJ9Jq3wbKdd9c9laV8ktGcYnzHbGyYmIOkyTamGHY3gHf2-N3x4nw3AcXr1mSKvQ3wYR5IysuSH1dyaScTJJiRybiyCye6Dj_OKaUm7ejnCKVW_t_CClQQFivAKPONZLfDq1VRhAdwHpx2Hcy0MnbiTRiBI0K7fvO2zWZ6HYBLlfkWo0agj9UMFbQKv8nF18%3D)

And on a fateful day, my team and I were traveling through the city of Baghdad. You have to understand that just getting around the region as Americans at this point was incredibly dangerous. We were told to stay in the middle lane of the highway, to keep as much of a distance between us and the explosive devices that lined the roads as possible. The terrorists were always waiting for their opportunity to attack. **_[Suddenly — it happened. ](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=0a70e169484947ea8eee14caa6b5cf38&_e=QMjIEC5-lBQsnS9VWUeDrP_QFn0OhYQSFS9No4zqg9GnB_eusRdKxQTz8uq5DO-hbflQ_1wH8nF8zq2HVuDyEhES1AwLVCzAg9mcVSV4PD4jIUfXPUZIxREmlpABdfVvTsEIT1LvMz8uskKyVz1bG5LV_VOxnp4LQ-nMkdEXXb3KaAngIxCR0sGv2tjwZvpIiblhvC734-DA9Mbhy5YitbGn_eeQE1lqXPhHQFJwKYkY5zWlrx2IKxEOGhijwwqMWX5P1_wqkkdj3CWUEApBsiywV_sdiFp_mHd_BJSy_CFdJ9Jq3wbKdd9c9laV8ktGcYnzHbGyYmIOkyTamGHY3hG2aTdWq_YKKGF7mIuknPhJzP5pVR0pMAHhP7HPIgDlJ80FYS6T03du2GYbARozjajOTIbWg8np25jTfrF3WVTPssauKkbwgjRWcxPJS4lRjyy5gf-mNC37CRadPTPWko94qxTIv5WJJnaVhAEB2Ig%3D)_** I can still remember what it was like to have my head spinning, with my ears ringing and surrounded by smoke. When I finally realized what happened, I was incredibly grateful to have made it out alive, as others in the car next to us were not as lucky. After this incident, my husband often jokes that when there’s a bump in the night at home,_he sends me to check things out and make sure we are safe_. **[But the truth is that my husband, Mike Rogers, is the strongest, most courageous, and honorable man I’ve ever known.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=0a70e169484947ea8eee14caa6b5cf38&_e=QMjIEC5-lBQsnS9VWUeDrP_QFn0OhYQSFS9No4zqg9GnB_eusRdKxQTz8uq5DO-hbflQ_1wH8nF8zq2HVuDyEhES1AwLVCzAg9mcVSV4PD4jIUfXPUZIxREmlpABdfVvTsEIT1LvMz8uskKyVz1bG5LV_VOxnp4LQ-nMkdEXXb3KaAngIxCR0sGv2tjwZvpIiblhvC734-DA9Mbhy5YitbGn_eeQE1lqXPhHQFJwKYkY5zWlrx2IKxEOGhijwwqMWX5P1_wqkkdj3CWUEApBsiywV_sdiFp_mHd_BJSy_CFdJ9Jq3wbKdd9c9laV8ktGcYnzHbGyYmIOkyTamGHY3n1TQJIfqhRSGwMtrx2CoUZTDEvqeMp5ElHz1qzajRqJYVAUbNDyZLqZ-hPwYYw-Dlv18cLPfLHa1kk1Dmo3N9KsUFLE1853uIv1Qztef6hsMcl0bb6t05_A_rdkd90MnJasz55D2sDCjRlmVvLhZIA%3D)** It takes guts to get back into politics these days — especially with the folks on the other side spending tens of millions of dollars to lie about you and your family in the name of scoring cheap political points. As a young man, Mike fought cancer and worked two jobs — one on the floor of an automotive factory, and one in security — just to put himself through college. My husband is an Army veteran, former FBI agent, and even chaired the House Intelligence Committee in the tough days after 9/11. He also has been taking the fight to Communist China — going so far as to break from his fellow Republicans to blow the whistle on the threats that the CCP poses. _It just doesn’t get any tougher than that. _
Mike is the kind of man that does what is right, no matter the personal consequence.

**[And he is the kind of man that is deserving of your support. Because with Mike in the Senate, you can know that there is someone in your corner, fighting for you and preserving our great American values.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=0a70e169484947ea8eee14caa6b5cf38&_e=QMjIEC5-lBQsnS9VWUeDrP_QFn0OhYQSFS9No4zqg9GnB_eusRdKxQTz8uq5DO-hbflQ_1wH8nF8zq2HVuDyEhES1AwLVCzAg9mcVSV4PD4jIUfXPUZIxREmlpABdfVvTsEIT1LvMz8uskKyVz1bG5LV_VOxnp4LQ-nMkdEXXb3KaAngIxCR0sGv2tjwZvpIiblhvC734-DA9Mbhy5YitbGn_eeQE1lqXPhHQFJwKYkY5zWlrx2IKxEOGhijwwqMWX5P1_wqkkdj3CWUEApBsiywV_sdiFp_mHd_BJSy_CFdJ9Jq3wbKdd9c9laV8ktGcYnzHbGyYmIOkyTamGHY3iqpjN03zIZv-wWyjoRQZ1QzsA5cZwVoPsnFMIOmd4lxMwUa4FfWHgVDCI1vr7bwe9Ajlbtx26fsBZYvZqZtQiHlqVmYm6yuq7z-bt6HRRktfu6w5QdUypJMC3LPtRoYUNqHBs0n9bBXlDHLUlo56NU%3D) **

clean_body: It rattled me, but did not break my American spirit | | | We don't want you to leave! But we understand if you don't want to receive these emails anymore. Click to unsubscribe. Friend, for well over a year now, you’ve been getting messages from my husband Mike Rogers, his campaign staff, and his supporters about how this is the most consequential election of our lifetime, why Mike is the best man for the job, and why if Mike wins, we take back the Senate. All of that is true. I was deployed to Iraq in the height of the conflict in the Middle East while working for the Department of Defense. Here’s a picture of me from back then: And on a fateful day, my team and I were traveling through the city of Baghdad. You have to understand that just getting around the region as Americans at this point was incredibly dangerous. We were told to stay in the middle lane of the highway, to keep as much of a distance between us and the explosive devices that lined the roads as possible. The terrorists were always waiting for their opportunity to attack. I can still remember what it was like to have my head spinning, with my ears ringing and surrounded by smoke. When I finally realized what happened, I was incredibly grateful to have made it out alive, as others in the car next to us were not as lucky. After this incident, my husband often jokes that when there’s a bump in the night at home,he sends me to check things out and make sure we are safe. It takes guts to get back into politics these days — especially with the folks on the other side spending tens of millions of dollars to lie about you and your family in the name of scoring cheap political points. As a young man, Mike fought cancer and worked two jobs — one on the floor of an automotive factory, and one in security — just to put himself through college. My husband is an Army veteran, former FBI agent, and even chaired the House Intelligence Committee in the tough days after 9/11. He also has been taking the fight to Communist China — going so far as to break from his fellow Republicans to blow the whistle on the threats that the CCP poses. It just doesn’t get any tougher than that. Mike is the kind of man that does what is right, no matter the personal consequence. Thank you for your time, thank you for your support and thank you for not giving up on politics and our great American experiment, Kristi Rogers | | Paid for by Rogers for Senate. | | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.commailto:mark@convert-digital.com. subject: SCOTUS must understand the dangers of ghost guns
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Ghost guns are real guns and pose a grave threat to public safety
#

The Supreme Court is about to decide whether ghost guns should remain illegal. It’s one of the most important cases of the year.
Ghost guns are untraceable firearms that can be made in minutes from kits and parts bought online. They’ve become the go-to source for gun traffickers and have been tied to thousands of crimes because they’re so easy to get without a trace.
The Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals struck down the portion of a 2022 federal rule that stemmed the tide of untraceable ghost guns by requiring serial numbers and background checks on sales. The Supreme Court will decide whether to uphold the decision.
Regulating ghost guns is critically important to public safety. When these firearms are in the hands of people who legally should not have a gun, it poses a grave risk to our public safety. The number of ghost guns recovered by law enforcement has increased by a staggering **1,000%** since 2016.
[**We are counting on the Supreme Court to make the right decision and stand on the side of public safety. Please, will you rush in a $3 contribution to our work here at GIFFORDS as we await oral arguments in this critical case to keep ghost guns regulated?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241008-1-30&t=1&akid=9149%2E3935704%2EJaB_j3)

In recent
years, there has been a noticeable shift among young Americans

raises a critical question: do they fully understand these two
systems' historical contexts and real-world outcomes?

To
address this, we have created a new eBook, The History of
Socialism and Capitalism, authored by two of the most prominent
voices in today's political discourse, Hoover Institution senior
fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.

This new
eBook offers a deep dive into the origins, development, and
impacts of socialism and capitalism. Each scholar presents an
in-depth analysis through two different lenses. It's hard to
overstate the relevance of this eBook in today's policy debates,
where radical proposals are gaining traction.

Understanding the historical and practical implications of
socialism and capitalism is crucial for making informed decisions
about our economic and political future. The insights provided by
Ferguson and Hanson will equip you with the knowledge to
critically evaluate these competing ideologies and their
potential impact on society.

Don't
miss this opportunity to enhance your understanding of these
pivotal economic systems. Click here to request your free copy of
The History of Socialism and Capitalism today.

Greg

To address this, we have created a new eBook, The History of Socialism and Capitalism, authored by two of the most prominent voices in today's political discourse, Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. This new eBook offers a deep dive into the origins, development, and impacts of socialism and capitalism. Each scholar presents an in-depth analysis through two different lenses. It's hard to overstate the relevance of this eBook in today's policy debates, where radical proposals are gaining traction. Understanding the historical and practical implications of socialism and capitalism is crucial for making informed decisions about our economic and political future. The insights provided by Ferguson and Hanson will equip you with the knowledge to critically evaluate these competing ideologies and their potential impact on society. Don't miss this opportunity to enhance your understanding of these pivotal economic systems. Click here to request your free copy of The History of Socialism and Capitalism today. name: The Democratic National Committee
subject: October 8, 2024.
body:
It is a day to remember.
---
**October 8, 2024.**
Today. The day we are asking you to make your first online donation to the Democratic National Committee. With Election Day right around the corner, we hope you’ll remember it as the day you did your part in helping elect Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats up and down the ballot. **$15.**
That is the amount we are asking you to contribute today. Usually, we ask first-time donors to make a gift of $3 or $7. But we’ll be honest: We are running out of time to reach voters. The DNC is the organization best positioned to move resources where they need to be when they need to be there in these final weeks. And that's just what we'll do with the $15 you give today. **November 6, 2024.**
That is the day AFTER the election ends. It's the day we want you to wake up knowing you did everything you could to make sure Democrats win BIG this Election Day. Polling shows that the presidential race is close. **_Extremely close_**. That’s why we need your support now more than ever. We're talking about nothing less than the future of our democracy. [**Can Democrats running for office everywhere count on you to contribute $15 directly to the Democratic National Committee today? Please use this link and we will put your donation right to work to fund our voter outreach efforts.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-elect-dems-2024?amount=15&refcode=em_20241008_1764_fr&refcode2=1774_22930333_rars32&akid=1774%2E22930333%2Erars32) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | | **[CONTRIBUTE $15](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-elect-dems-2024?express_lane=true&amount=15&refcode=em_20241008_1764_fr&refcode2=1774_22930333_rars32&akid=1774%2E22930333%2Erars32)**

#
Our campaign strategy team has been busy crunching numbers and although it is extremely tight,**there is a path to victory!**
WA05 is ready for common sense, pro-labor leadership!
When we knock on doors and make phone calls - WE CAN turn out the votes we need!If every person reading this newsletter knocks on 50 doors or makes 75 phone calls, we can win!

---

**Ballots begin to drop this week.**
**Will you join us to bring common sense leadership to WA 05?**

Visit [**MOBILIZE**](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=01557c1d59&e=a7b299e420)**** to find a variety of volunteer options.

Welcome to another episode of Hate Mail of the Weak. This week we cover the response from racists, outraged that I dared condemn the killing of civilians and American citizens.
I periodically share this more personal side of my advocacy for human rights because it is important to me that you, my gracious supporters, see what I see. Apologies in advance for the harsh language in the screen shots below.
**Let 's Address This **in a new issue of "**Hate Mail of the Weak**."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/57fcecde-c472-481e-949d-79ed434e5a75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..VMXN1QQyVEqFifdQypLIChb0MJ89XEIItlfJpuhbM1w?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149949114)
It started when a I made a public plea to uphold the Leahy Laws and the will of the vast majority of Americans--and stop funding Netanyahu to bomb civilians. I wrote the following tweet in respond to Antony Blinken announcing $157M in aid to Lebanon.
As a reminder, it's true that the vast majority of Americans--more than 61%--want the United States to uphold human rights law and stop funding Netanyahu.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f2f32ff2-8086-4f16-a795-8f66dfb6801f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The responses were not so forgiving, and called me "terrorist" for my crime of advocating for peace and justice. I suppose I'm left wondering if this person considers 61% of all Americans, or 203M people, terrorists as well?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8a7b42de-7307-4dbe-9272-72005edee6a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The irony is that meanwhile, this person follows me on social media. Maybe I'm just old fashioned but I tend to _not_ follow people who I believe are "terrorist shills."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..VMXN1QQyVEqFifdQypLIChb0MJ89XEIItlfJpuhbM1w?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149949114)
As my tweet gained popularity, more right wing extremists decided to enter the discourse. Apparently calling for peace means you're a "terrorist" and "hate America."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/568a2e59-ed72-4eb3-9231-0306b1772c7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I am reminded instead of the wisdom of the late, great, James Baldwin, who beautifully said, "_I love America more than any other country in the world and, exactly for this reason, I insist on the right to criticize her perpetually_."
Next, I admit I was caught off guard with the accusation from a person named Buddy. Now, somehow calling for peace and a stoppage of arms trade means "racism against white people." I'm not sure how that works, but it is fascinating what people must think of themselves if they see a call for an end to war as somehow "anti-white."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/497c0b34-8752-408a-94b2-5749d6e63e2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And the final icing on the bitter cake came from Jack Robinson, who viewed condemnations of a foreign government killing an American citizen as "supporting terrorism." Remarkable how "America first" goes out the window so easily.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/99c1e37a-6ef4-41a3-84f4-d6fa6c086cdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
To be sure, this is just a snapshot of the 1000+ such messages I received in the last week--all for my 'crime' of calling for a ceasefire, release of all hostages, and an end to hostilities. Sadly these are the times in which we live, and they reemphasize how much more critical it is we activate, organize, and be relentless in our calls for justice and humanity.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..VMXN1QQyVEqFifdQypLIChb0MJ89XEIItlfJpuhbM1w?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149949114)
Our response must instead be to continue to share our stories and our values of inclusion and compassion. We do this by investing our time and resources to elevate people doing the work and building that more just and compassionate future. You have my promise to always speak up and uphold justice above all else, period. Let us continue to demand that more humane and just future for this generation and the next.
**In closing, let me reemphasize my appreciation to each of you for supporting my work and advocacy.** Whether you [subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/8569b138-8c73-4905-8573-e78ecfb40514?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for free, or at $6/mo, or at $50/year, or sign up as a Founding Member at $500/year--your support to keep building is critical.

subject: Did you hear what Google did?
body:
This is a David vs. Goliath battle | | | [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=606c4ddf028149fb9147389404f6ea80&_e=j2X3G9bDB_vviwlHMLBO9g_vjbGmZlKPpsIa12TIQPkJtPbqNU3sWK8hUu82jB-_dLizB6Llw-6QZSCPo27_Kty3Q_j-ihJ0bLZx6tksNlrPt8zrYL49rUasJWYKJQ8waFTV3ArtO8PcBr_47GPdjULI_BmO9z4NYfsTBehmuK7F2HVVt2uGY-OUcAkYuqajTUt5Gz00OlXMOLWk0xMw6VBzzh-ASxrGMZNWsLk6oIrD5AMvEiOS_4gijN1F2m0HC3tsWiHIe4CXRgif5ZNwkQ%3D%3D)
---
| | In case you missed it, Google recently removed the PragerU app from the Play Store without warning. Only after our app disappeared from Google’s platform did they bother to notify us that it had been suspended and removed indefinitely for “Violation of Hate Speech.”
---
[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=606c4ddf028149fb9147389404f6ea80&_e=j2X3G9bDB_vviwlHMLBO9g_vjbGmZlKPpsIa12TIQPkJtPbqNU3sWK8hUu82jB-_dLizB6Llw-6QZSCPo27_Kty3Q_j-ihJ0bLZx6tksNlrPt8zrYL49rUasJWYKJQ8wtWqwfPC4xdlLd4E6OggMESkp3eIa2MJMdG7ZlFfdgMJNJTXDdnWwzNdkPzcVIB-eOT4qtz3Pw3popOpOiGAVaESTqqBAKKx4-_zT2EB5vKuUqsjhMoslPsWib_jc4JJchiSQVm_UX3fNdi2rRfQ9Aw%3D%3D)
---
[**Stand Up to Big Tech**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=606c4ddf028149fb9147389404f6ea80&_e=j2X3G9bDB_vviwlHMLBO9g_vjbGmZlKPpsIa12TIQPkJtPbqNU3sWK8hUu82jB-_dLizB6Llw-6QZSCPo27_Kty3Q_j-ihJ0bLZx6tksNlrPt8zrYL49rUasJWYKJQ8w5IFI-kWFlt9dbLaUvo6BkK0pGzfF7GWwGzWMgXAXB2fBQjc5fMU-Ahc_1mEzMqsYPHfS80uNDnt7fpLmhpQk5NB2flx0O6LhmFE27U2yf-ByY3fAZq93knc1ENXDiZElzZGSgQ-qgGEgJN2I2oqGqw%3D%3D)
---
In the email from Google, they said our app contained “content or speech asserting that a protected group is inhuman, inferior, or worthy of being hated,” referring to our recently released short documentary, **Dear Infidels: A Warning to America** , which features first-hand accounts from individuals who escaped the oppressive grip of radical Islamic rule. According to Google, sharing the stories of a former Palestinian refugee, an Arab Muslim born in Israel, and brave U.S. Navy SEALs who witnessed the horrors of Muslim extremism constitutes “hate speech.” **Dear Infidels** went viral on social media, reaching millions of people! Like clockwork, Big Tech reared its ugly head to shut us down and suppress our reach. We immediately jumped into action and began sounding the alarm. Thanks to our dedicated followers and supporters, Big Tech did NOT win, and their Soviet-style censorship tactics were thwarted. | In late September, Republican Congressman Paul Gosar of Arizona’s 9th District introduced H.R. 9828 in the US House of Representatives. Titled “The Public Health Service Act to end the liability shield for vaccine manufacturers, and for other purposes,” the bill serves to **overturn aspects of the 1986 National Childhood Vaccine Injury Act**. These changes would allow victims of vaccine-induced injuries and deaths to obtain **legal compensation from vaccine manufacturers** by stripping these corporations of the immunity from liability afforded to them by NCVIA.
The bill boasts an **impressive list of 30 cosponsors** , including five from the Texas congressional delegation. Interestingly, not one Democrat has signed on to this vital legislation.
Texans for Vaccine Choice ardently supports this bill, which would allow for much needed justice for victims by r**estoring liability back to the vaccine manufacturers** , and we applaud Representative Paul Gosar in his pursuit. We would also like to remind you that 99% of vaccine policy is set at the state level, and if this bill were to pass, it would be just ONE** step towards holding Big Pharma accountable**, after years of their relentless pursuit of medical mandates.

## For the New York City Office of Public Advocate
---
| |
### Hello, Peter
---
| | In August, we filed an exploratory interest, and today, following the latest City Hall debacle, I'm confirming my candidacy for the role of Public Advocate.

We are all forced to live with the problems created by bail reform, sanctuary city policies, low standards, corruption, and dishonesty. The New Yorkers I met during my congressional campaign asked, "Is NYC beyond repair?"

I say no. We all know New York has bounced back before. Our campaign will call on you, the voters, to perform your civic duty and vote for leaders focused on core issues.

NYC should be a role model for municipal excellence. To achieve this, we need to change two things.

First, we need to confront incompetence at City Hall along with the dishonest Socialist mentality of trying to make everyone happy, which instead has made the majority of New Yorkers worse off.

Therefore, in addition to voting out Eric Adams, I call on NYC’s voters to clean house and replace Brad Lander and Jumaane Williams. The entire team that created this mess has to go.

Second, we must focus NYC on municipal excellence — safety, sanitation, schools, and infrastructure — not non-core issues such as international wars, illegal campus protests, and dangerous experiments in criminal law.

NYC should attract outstanding people for all jobs, trim its budget and cut taxes, speed up some programs, eliminate others, and, most importantly, revitalize New Yorkers’ belief in the greatest city in the world.

A back-to-basics strategy will refocus NYC on doing fewer things but doing them exceptionally well as measured on a global standard.

It is time for NYC to retake the lead. You bring your votes, and I will bring my international and financial expertise to help NYC achieve municipal excellence in its core functions.

body:
Jeff Bartos | B+L Featured Columnist | | | |

---
| **__Jeff Bartos:_ Fighting antisemitism and supporting Israel in the year since October 7_**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=152df8f160&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
| "... Early on the morning of October 7, 2023, my wife Sheryl and I woke to the terrible news in Israel and could not even begin to comprehend what was happening.

After scouring American and Israeli news outlets, I spoke with our daughters and tried, unsuccessfully, to alleviate their anxiety and sorrow as they tried to make sense of the incomprehensible videos and news from Israel. Thereafter followed a series of calls with family and friends in the United States and WhatsApp messages with friends in Israel as we watched, in horror, as the scope of the atrocities came into focus..."

I just made a very difficult decision
_[Click here to stop receiving emails about Dan Osborn's campaign in Nebraska from us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94557625/503882299/1647001491?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMmU2YjA1ZC04ZTg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TpT0IEQRrdEvkJsbqZoSx2kzXa8PCAZRzFyTp5Tv_Gg=&emci=c7f8cf0e-fb84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=32e6b05d-8e85-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=19445147)_
Hello,

body:
Fighting back against abortion bans
Peter,

Yesterday, reproductive rights took a devastating hit in Georgia. The Georgia Supreme Court reinstated a law that bans abortion at six-weeks—before most people even know they're pregnant.
This ban has already cost the lives of at least two women—both mothers—whose deaths shortly after the ban took effect in 2022 were deemed "preventable" by Georgia's Maternal Mortality Review Committee. And now, this new ruling places even more lives in jeopardy. Despite knowing this, Attorney General Carr pushed to reinstate this ban, endangering countless Georgians’ health and autonomy.
But we won’t give up on fighting this extreme ban. [**With your support, we’re fighting for the right of every Georgian to make decisions about their bodies, health, and futures.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94558074/503883649/2141984067?sourceid=1149885&utm_campaign=25emage-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=georgia&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiY2YyZjJkNi04ZTg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MxGgliuXWqlm2Psth9JFe35fpCkLEDiB9OvWHIxwnD8=&emci=23bf3b30-8085-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=bcf2f2d6-8e85-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=954237)

Judge Robert McBurney didn't just strike down the law, but criticized it for forcing women to be "human incubators." He stated, _"Women are not some piece of collectively owned community property the disposition of which is decided by majority vote."_

This victory comes less than three weeks after a North Dakota judge struck down that state's abortion ban in a separate case The Center is litigating. In fact, the Georgia decision cites our North Dakota win.

[**We're determined to sustain this momentum to strike down other abortion bans and build state constitutional protections nationwide.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94558080/503883655/2141984067?sourceid=1149885&utm_campaign=25emage-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=georgia&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiY2YyZjJkNi04ZTg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MxGgliuXWqlm2Psth9JFe35fpCkLEDiB9OvWHIxwnD8=&emci=23bf3b30-8085-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=bcf2f2d6-8e85-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=954237)

This critical win, led by the Center for Reproductive Rights alongside our partners, means that clinicians can once again provide vital care without fear of criminalization. [**Your support allows the Center to fight for abortion rights in court—and the rulings in Georgia and North Dakota prove that when we fight, we can win!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94558081/503883657/2141984067?sourceid=1149885&utm_campaign=25emage-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=georgia&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiY2YyZjJkNi04ZTg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MxGgliuXWqlm2Psth9JFe35fpCkLEDiB9OvWHIxwnD8=&emci=23bf3b30-8085-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=bcf2f2d6-8e85-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=954237)

| | | Donald Trump's slide into dementia has been obvious for anyone watching his increasingly unhinged and irrational behavior. And yet, major media has largely ignored it. **But now the New York Times has meticulously [analyzed](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4631cf0d-157c-42aa-9b7d-5bedec0dbddc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) and documented it, and shown clear evidence of a frightening descent.** _" He rambles, he repeats himself, he roams from thought to thought — some of them hard to understand, some of them unfinished, some of them factually fantastical. He voices outlandish claims that seem to be made up out of whole cloth. He digresses into bizarre tangents about golf, about sharks, about his own "beautiful"body. He relishes "a great day in Louisiana"after spending the day in Georgia."_ And they're backing it with data: _" Similarly, he uses 32 percent more negative words than positive words now, compared with 21 percent in 2016, which can be another indicator of cognitive change. And he uses swearwords 69 percent more often than he did when he first ran, a trend that could reflect what experts call disinhibition."_ The NY Times deserves credit for this important work. And now it's time for other major media to stop ignoring this story and start reporting on Trump's descent as soon as possible. [**Add your name, and tell the media to follow The NY Times lead, and start reporting on Trump's slide into dementia.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T71ac70eb-76e8-408c-8dc4-ee3312e83519/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
We’ve got to push incredibly hard to raise what we need between tomorrow’s debate and this next FEC filing.
#

Hey Peter, it’s Ruben. I want to be real with you here:
Things are about to get a little crazy, but please. Stick with me.
Tomorrow, I face off against Kari Lake at our debate. That same day, Arizona starts voting. And a week after that is our final pre-election FEC filing. The last one of the race, officially.
I owe you some unvarnished honesty here: We’ve got to push incredibly hard to raise what we need between tomorrow’s debate and this next FEC filing. I’m writing in part to apologize in advance for how much we’re going to be reaching out over the next week.
But I’m also writing to remind you that there’s a reason we’re doing it. It’s not to annoy you or stress you out. It’s because emails like this, texts, digital ads — these are the biggest columns in our budget. Donations from folks like you are the main way we fund this campaign.
If I could win this race without sending a single email, I’d do it. But I can tell you with 100% certainty that if we don’t email... we won’t raise what we need. We won’t be able to reach the voters we have to turn out. We’d be setting ourselves up to hand this seat over to Kari Lake.
I can’t let that happen, and I think you agree with me there.
You are a critical part of this team. And with that apology, with this explanation, I hope you understand how important you really are to all of this.

------------------------------------------------------------

Want to help Drew and make sure Republicans maintain control of the House of Representatives? We need your help! This race is going to be tight, and having supporters like you step up and lend a hand is vital!

Here are the TOP 4 ways YOU can get involved:

1. Donate: Simply chipping in a few dollars to support our efforts is incredibly helpful. Whether it's $3 or $3,000, every donation makes a huge difference! Just $18 buys coffee and donuts for volunteers! You can contribute to the campaign HERE (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=6a7c510d3c&e=fc26432468) .

2. Host a Meet-and-Greet for Drew: Hosting a Meet-and-Greet in your home for Drew and inviting your friends, family, and neighbors is one of the best ways to spread our message. Whether it’s a casual coffee meeting, a wine and cheese event, or a fun game night, we can make hosting easy. Interested in hosting a meet-and-greet? Email linnea@drewfornevada.com (mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20for%20Drew!) .

3. Volunteer for the Campaign: #TeamDrew is the secret weapon that will get Drew elected to Congress. We're knocking on tens of thousands of doors, writing thousands of postcards, and making as many phone calls as possible to make this campaign a success. And we can't do it without you! Please visit THIS (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=2fec62d249&e=fc26432468) link to join #TeamDrew as a volunteer.

4. Put up a Yard Sign: One of the easiest and most effective ways to support our campaign is by putting a "Drew Johnson for Congress" sign in your yard. Almost every HOA in Southern Nevada allows at least one campaign yard sign. body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94564399/503904708/158001685?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzU3MGJkNzYtOTc4NS1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZQaQ8njWhThLZsrbJOyBSdchZekwI8adm-4HrRg7NnU=) It’s official, team. | | We are less than one month from Election Day. I have worked hard to support legislation that aligns with our values in Northwest Washington,**but there is more work to do**. With less than one month left, it is time for each of us to remember the stakes of this election. We cannot afford to sit on the sidelines. **It is an honor to represent the 2nd District**. Our shared values – working hard, caring for each other, and serving the community – guide my work in Congress to serve my friends and neighbors. I am committed to protecting reproductive freedom, combatting fentanyl in our communities, building an economy that works for everyone, increasing access to affordable health care, and supporting our veterans. We need to vote to protect this work up and down the ballot in November. Each of us needs to do our part. When Democrats take back Congress, we will make Roe v. Wade the law of the land; we will fight for affordable healthcare; and we will work to lower the cost of living for everyone. **I am proud to have brought $500 million from the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to the 2nd District to revitalize our communities and create jobs.** For many in Northwest Washington, our jobs are not just an occupation – they are a source of dignity. That is why I support raising the federal minimum wage to $15 per hour, guaranteeing equal pay for equal work, providing skills training across sectors and especially for our youth, and growing the strength of organized labor. One month from November 5 is an important reminder for us all: every day between now and Election Day can help us build the momentum to take back Congress and make progress. clean_body: We are less than one month from Election Day. | | | | We are less than one month from Election Day. I have worked hard to support legislation that aligns with our values in Northwest Washington,but there is more work to do. With less than one month left, it is time for each of us to remember the stakes of this election. We cannot afford to sit on the sidelines. It is an honor to represent the 2nd District. Our shared values – working hard, caring for each other, and serving the community – guide my work in Congress to serve my friends and neighbors. I am committed to protecting reproductive freedom, combatting fentanyl in our communities, building an economy that works for everyone, increasing access to affordable health care, and supporting our veterans. We need to vote to protect this work up and down the ballot in November. Each of us needs to do our part. When Democrats take back Congress, we will make Roe v. Wade the law of the land; we will fight for affordable healthcare; and we will work to lower the cost of living for everyone. I am proud to have brought $500 million from the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to the 2nd District to revitalize our communities and create jobs. For many in Northwest Washington, our jobs are not just an occupation – they are a source of dignity. That is why I support raising the federal minimum wage to $15 per hour, guaranteeing equal pay for equal work, providing skills training across sectors and especially for our youth, and growing the strength of organized labor. One month from November 5 is an important reminder for us all: every day between now and Election Day can help us build the momentum to take back Congress and make progress. * **TOP NEWS**

**" Supreme Court declines Biden's appeal in Texas emergency abortion case,"** AP's**Lindsay Whitehurst** and **Jamie Stengle** -- "[The Supreme Court](https://substack.com/redirect/4bfc288a-ed85-4d65-8eae-1b7dbd54ad72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Monday let stand a decision barring [emergency abortions](https://substack.com/redirect/dc5a1f75-c4fd-473a-bd67-1e9aabdd3b44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that violate the law in Texas, which has one of the country's strictest abortion bans.

The justices did not detail their reasoning for keeping in place a [lower court order](https://substack.com/redirect/a75b5201-d7d7-4088-9783-a4983fc8c6d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that said hospitals cannot be required to provide pregnancy terminations if they would break Texas law. There were no publicly noted dissents.

The decision comes weeks before a presidential election where abortion has been a key issue after the high court's 2022 [decision overturning the nationwide right to abortion](https://substack.com/redirect/87493e40-8624-425d-a02c-bfa9b391051f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The state's strict abortion ban has been a centerpiece of Democratic U.S. Rep. **Colin Allred 's **challenge against Republican U.S. Sen. **Ted Cruz** for his seat.

At a campaign event over the weekend in Fort Worth, Texas, hundreds of Allred's supporters broke out in raucous applause when he vowed to protect a woman's right to an abortion. "When I'm in the Senate, we're going to restore Roe v. Wade," Allred said.

At a separate event the same day, in a nearby suburb, Cruz outlined a litany of criticisms against Allred, but didn't bring up the abortion law.

The justices rebuffed a Biden administration push to throw out the lower court order. [The administration argues](https://substack.com/redirect/d9ad05a9-aeb1-4902-b80b-a230e5ae207c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that under federal law hospitals must perform abortions if needed in cases where a pregnant patient's health or life is at serious risk, even in states where it's banned." * **TOP NEWS**

**" Supreme Court declines Biden's appeal in Texas emergency abortion case,"** AP's**Lindsay Whitehurst** and **Jamie Stengle** -- "[The Supreme Court](https://substack.com/redirect/270a6de8-f047-4125-9ef5-fcbd5c64910b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Monday let stand a decision barring [emergency abortions](https://substack.com/redirect/f7cc0d2c-b799-4c8c-9816-85c965dfe88d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that violate the law in Texas, which has one of the country's strictest abortion bans.

The justices did not detail their reasoning for keeping in place a [lower court order](https://substack.com/redirect/5d932aef-801a-475b-a08c-d2c06fe85388?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that said hospitals cannot be required to provide pregnancy terminations if they would break Texas law. There were no publicly noted dissents.

The decision comes weeks before a presidential election where abortion has been a key issue after the high court's 2022 [decision overturning the nationwide right to abortion](https://substack.com/redirect/27685ca7-34fa-471f-b254-2921eba9d222?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The state's strict abortion ban has been a centerpiece of Democratic U.S. Rep. **Colin Allred 's **challenge against Republican U.S. Sen. **Ted Cruz** for his seat.

At a campaign event over the weekend in Fort Worth, Texas, hundreds of Allred's supporters broke out in raucous applause when he vowed to protect a woman's right to an abortion. "When I'm in the Senate, we're going to restore Roe v. Wade," Allred said.

At a separate event the same day, in a nearby suburb, Cruz outlined a litany of criticisms against Allred, but didn't bring up the abortion law.

name: Matthew Davis, LCV
subject: TAKE ACTION: The Senate could soon approve a BIG giveaway to Big Polluters.
body:
Help us reach 8,000 signatures to protect our communities, lands, and waters.

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTE2MDEzNzQS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjA4MDEzNTY3NwS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
| |
## **Take Action: Stop the Senate from Handing Over Public Lands and Waters to Polluters**
The Senate’s powerful Energy and Natural Resources Committee has approved big handouts to fossil fuel executives that will harm our communities and lock in decades of fossil fuel emissions. The committee has paired these handouts with improvements in transmission siting policy. (We at LCV are fighting for improved transmission _without_ contributing to fossil fuels’ continued dominance.) The bill, sponsored by Senators Manchin (D-WV) and Barrasso (R-WY), could be jammed into a must-pass bill to be considered by the full Senate. We need a HUGE show of force from environmentalists like you to stop this handover of America’s lands and waters to Big Oil and other corporate polluters. [**_We’ve set a goal to deliver 8,000 petition signatures this week. Please take action right now to help us reach our goal >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | | [ TAKE ACTION NOW ](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | | | DEVELOPING — A dangerous proposal to hand over untold acres of public lands and waters to polluters is currently gaining momentum in the Senate. The environmental movement needs to act _quickly_ to protect fragile landscapes, already overburdened communities, and our climate goals.
---
| | Here’s the situation, Peter: before the Senate left Washington for their summer recess, Senators Manchin (D-WV) and Barrasso (R-WY) sprung a proposal to fast-track federal approval for dirty energy, transmission, and other projects on their colleagues. They then scheduled a last-minute committee vote, advancing their bill to the full Senate.
---
| | [**This legislation would harm our communities and our climate —** _**and we need your help to stop it**_**.**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/7RYwsXXeb_)**Their bill calls for:**
---
| |
* **Giving away our public lands and waters to Big Oil** by extending drilling permits.
* Holding more **mandatory auctions for fossil fuel companies to scoop up public lands** and waters for pennies on the dollar.
* Allowing mining companies to **use unlimited public lands as dumping sites for toxic waste.**
* Rubber-stamping a **massive buildout of climate harming liquified methane gas (LNG)** exports.
* **Jamming communities, particularly low-income communities and communities of color,** on any attempts to pursue their day in court on massive, potentially damaging projects.

---
| | | [ TAKE ACTION >> ](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzs~~)
---
| | Peter, put simply: **this bill would force the federal government to ignore or bypass critical environmental safeguards,**_**giving more handouts to fossil fuel executives**_ who put their profits ahead of our health and safety.
---
| | Congress could begin taking up this legislation soon after the election. We need a huge show of force from environmentalists like you to prevent this massive giveaway to polluters from sneaking into any must-pass legislation.
---
| | [**_Please, act now. Help us reach 8,000 signatures to stop the Senate from handing over our lands and waters to big polluters and cutting communities out of decisions that could harm them >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ambdF664W~)
---
| | Thanks for standing up to Big Oil, Peter. Together, I know that we can protect our communities, lands, our waters, and our climate.
---
| | Onward,
---
| | Matthew Davis
Vice President of Federal Policy
League of Conservation Voters
---
