name: Supervisor David Canepa
subject: 2024 October e-newsletter
body:
| | | |
---
| | |
# 2024 October e-newsletter
---
|
---
|
---
| **Board chambers now open to public at 500 County Center**
---
| Dear friends, The Board of Supervisors held its first meeting at 500 County Center September 24 when we approved a $5.25 billion budget for this fiscal year, the largest in San Mateo County’s history. I was excited to see the Board Chambers packed to capacity bright and early at 9 a.m. as the Board also voted to increase the amount set aside for General Fund reserves in the budget to 15 percent from 10 percent to ensure financial stability and maintain essential services particularly for underserved residents during economic downturns.
---
The budget reflects the values of the Board as we have prioritized constructing and rehabilitating affordable housing, ending homelessness, emergency preparedness, the needs of children, families and seniors with mental health being considered across all of these priority areas. The Board also proudly renamed Tunitas Creek Beach the Don Horsley County Park at Tunitas Creek Beach in honor of the former supervisor and sheriff who died earlier this year. The Board meets next 9 a.m., Tuesday, Oct. 8, Board Chambers, 500 County Center, Redwood City.
---
| **500 County Center hosts first major reception to celebrate the county’s past, present and future** Seven years ago, the vision of bringing a new county center came to life. I started this vision with the late Don Horsley in 2017 and continued through the years with current Board President Warren Slocum as we worked on a subcommittee together that prioritized climate change resiliency and the creation of a space that connected San Mateo County residents in a welcoming way to county government and services. I was incredibly proud to host a welcoming reception Sept. 19 at 500 County Center, the greenest civic building in the United States with guests including foreign dignitaries, former 49er greats, tech executives, my constituents and California State Controller Malia Cohen.
---

The keynote speaker was the building’s architect and abstract artist Javier Arizmendi, who spoke about the green aspects of the building, as it is the first civic building in the nation to be constructed with cross laminate timber. The reception also showcased an art exhibit featuring works by local artists including Arizmendi from the Andra Norris Gallery in Burlingame. The highlight of the night was perhaps when world-renowned singer Roxana Damas sang the National Anthem on the fifth-floor veranda overlooking the historic cupola that survived the 1906 earthquake and adorns the San Mateo County History Museum. Thanks for all who attended, it was a pleasure to see you all and to celebrate the county’s past, present and future.
---
|

**‘Loneliness to Light’ gathering highlights county’s commitment to connectivity**

Thank you to all who attended my office’s Loneliness to Light gathering in partnership with the Center for Age-Friendly Excellence (CAFÉ) Tuesday, Oct. 1 at the Regional Operations Center in Redwood City.

The event featured Dr. Anabel Pelham with CAFÉ, keynote speaker UCSF Dr. Carla Perissinotto, and Dr. Elissa Lee with California Volunteers in the Governor’s Office who all spoke on our collective efforts to raise awareness around the epidemic of loneliness. San Mateo County was the first in the nation to declare loneliness a public health crisis in January.

The event also showcased numerous projects and programs several cities have embraced to improve the lives of older adults under the Age-Friendly Cities Initiative my office has championed since 2018.

In Brisbane, the city has adopted several intergenerational programs to connect older adults and youth with karaoke nights, reading programs for preschoolers and the city’s Youth Advisory Committee offering tech support for older adults.

In Daly City, Mayor Juslyn Manalo spoke about its Intergenerational Music Therapy Program in partnership with Northeast Medical Services and a Hawaiian-themed “senior” prom that had 259 participants. The cities of Belmont, San Carlos and Redwood City also highlighted some of its programs at the event. To date 16 San Mateo County cities are now certified Age-Friendly by the World Health Organization which helps us all connect in new and meaningful ways.

To learn more, go to: [https://cfafe.org](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=8be4edbc0f&e=c0babbc643)/

---
|

**GotWheels! expands to give older adults mobility options**

As Peninsula Family Service celebrates the fifth anniversary of GotWheels!, which started in Daly City in 2019, I’m proud to announce I have secured $900,000 this year alone from the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors and Metropolitan Transportation Commission to expand this low-cost transportation program for older adults across the county.

It’s a partnership with Serra Yellow Cab, shown in the picture above providing a ride for Daly City resident Norma Irving, which is the only wheelchair-accessible taxi service in the county.

Getting out of the house is an incredible way to connect with your community and break free from social isolation and loneliness.

Got Wheels! is available around-the-clock, for a cost of $5, to help older adults who may have mobility issues, and those who can’t drive due to not having a driver’s license, lack of driving skills or not owning a car.

The service, which can be used up to six times a month (six one-way trips or three roundtrips), is available to residents 70 years and above in Daly City, Colma, Brisbane, South San Francisco, San Bruno, San Francisco International Airport, Millbrae, Burlingame, Hillsborough, Half Moon Bay, Moss Beach, El Granada and Montara.

To learn more, go to: [https://peninsulafamilyservice.org/got-wheels/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=3c6a296fb3&e=c0babbc643)
---
| **
Bay Wheels bikeshare to grow in Daly City**

The Metropolitan Transportation Commission in partnership with Lyft launched the first Bay Wheels bikeshare station in San Mateo County at the Daly City BART station earlier this year and I’m proud to say as an MTC Commissioner, I have helped secure another $1 million to expand the service in Daly City with up to 80 additional e-bikes and 8 to 12 new docking stations throughout the city.

These stations pave the way for safer bicycling and its successful debut at Daly City BART, the ninth busiest in the system, has prompted MTC in partnership with Daly City to provide more funding and support for Bay Wheels’ expansion.

It’s a last-mile commute solution that is better for the environment and better for the mind and body. Today, Amsterdam is considered to be the most bike-friendly in the entire world, but it was only a few decades ago that the city’s streets were clogged with cars like we are now. I’m proud to be a part of a growing movement that shows what a little pedal power can do.

The new docking station marks the first Bay Wheels location in San Mateo County and the continuation of a growth strategy that began last fall with the introduction of more than 1,500 new e-bikes and 30 new docking stations in San Francisco and San Jose.

Launched in 2017, Bay Wheels is the Bay Area’s regional bikeshare program with over 6,000 bicycles — both pedal-powered and pedal-assist electric bikes — at more than 500 stations in San Jose, San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley, Emeryville and Daly City. Lyft operates Bay Wheels under a contract managed by MTC.
---
| **Interns wanted to join our team ** We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=a66c72dda8&e=c0babbc643). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [tbayudan@smcgov.org](mailto:tbayudan@smcgov.org) .
---
| **Battling food insecurity **
Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: [https://www.cdss.ca.gov/food-nutrition/calfresh](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=d1e11f4a66&e=c0babbc643) Contact: (650) 802-6576, [antorres@smcgov.org](mailto:antorres@smcgov.org) **Daly City Partnership:**
DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: [https://www.dcpartnership.org/covid19/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=23aaed3a8a&e=c0babbc643) **Second Harvest Food Bank:**
Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: [https://www.shfb.org/get-food/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=e9b5a5799d&e=c0babbc643) Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 In friendship,
David J. Canepa
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| | |
---
| _Copyright © 2024 Supervisor David Canepa, All rights reserved._
You are receiving this email because you opted in via our website.

**Our mailing address is:**
Supervisor David Canepa1618 Sullivan497Daly City, CA 94015
[Add us to your address book](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/vcard?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ea541c4b96)

Want to change how you receive these emails?
You can [update your preferences](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/profile?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ea541c4b96&e=c0babbc643&c=9442515c4d) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ea541c4b96&t=b&e=c0babbc643&c=9442515c4d).

Bill Gray, '01

Friend, it's been a busy last few weeks!
It's Lt. Governor Sara Rodriguez, and recently I've been hard at work campaigning across Wisconsin!
When I say I'm focused on helping Democrats win up and down the ballot from Chippewa Falls to Cedarburg (and everywhere in between), I mean it.
One of the most exciting stops was when I joined the Harris-Walz campaign's "Fighting for Reproductive Freedom" bus tour with Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer.
Check out this picture from a recent event ⬇️
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241008_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241008_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP]
We traveled across the state to energize voters by highlighting Project 2025 and holding Trump accountable for overturning Roe v. Wade.
The work doesn't stop there—I've also been speaking about childcare with Gwen Walz and talking to retirees about what Trump's Project 2025 would do to Social Security and Medicare.
Friend, I'm working as hard as I can to ensure that Wisconsin votes for Kamala Harris and that we elect champions of freedoms down ballot across Wisconsin this November. Can you help me do that by chipping in today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241008_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP]
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241008_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP]
In service,
Lt. Gov Sara Rodriguez
Lt. Gov. Sara Rodriguez, MSN, MPH, RN, was sworn in as Wisconsin’s 46th Lieutenant Governor on January 3, 2023. A working mom, wife, and proud Wisconsinite, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was elected on November 8, 2022. Before her election, she served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Assembly District 13, comprising a portion of Waukesha and Milwaukee Counties. While serving as a state representative, she worked on the Committees on Health, Insurance, Energy and Utilities, and Science, Technology and Broadband.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241008_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241008_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP]
Lt. Gov. Rodriguez is an experienced healthcare executive who has worked in various leadership roles for over 20 years, including founding her own small business. Prior to serving in the Wisconsin State Assembly, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was the vice president of Population Health and Integrated Care Management at one of the largest healthcare systems in the Midwest. In this role, she provided strategic direction to the teams that managed population health interventions for risk-based contracts and direct-to-employer products.
Before running for office, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez built a career in public health and population health management. She held positions with public health departments at the local, state, and federal levels, including serving as an epidemic intelligence service officer with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the chronic disease director for the state of Colorado, a healthcare systems consultant, and a vice president at a Fortune 100 Company.

Hi, it's Brian King's team reaching out. This is a bit of a long email, but it's important. Before you read it, [**can you consider pitching in what you can to our campaign today? As you'll see, we're up against a well-funded opponent, and any amount helps. >>**](https://king4ut.us/l/GqNuahlF1ivV) Recent campaign finance reports show exactly who's funding Gov. Cox and why he's taken steps to make our government less transparent. **_Of the millions his reelection campaign has raised, "nearly 7 of every 10 dollars donated have come from corporations or PACs."_** State campaign finance records have also shown that those with a direct stake in decisions made by Gov. Cox's appointees donated **_large sums_** to his campaign. _The Salt Lake Tribune_ reported, _"During a three-month period when the governor-appointed state engineer was reviewing a controversial lithium extraction application from an Australian company, Gov. Spencer Cox’s reelection campaign accepted a $10,000 donation from the company’s U.S. subsidiary."_ **_In other words, a foreign company directed its U.S. subsidiary to give him 10,000 reasons to approve their application._** Almost as soon as it hit his desk, Gov. Cox also signed a bill into law reversing decades of precedent and keeping the calendars of elected officials and government employees secret. **In response, Brian published his entire calendar online for people to see.** He isn't taking secret meetings with shady figures or asking for donations from Super PACs—he's running a people-powered campaign to serve Utahns and be a leader that they can trust—for the better. [**With less than a month until the election, we need to get our message out there. We can't let large donations from corporations and PACs drown out our voice. Can you please make a grassroots contribution today and help our people-powered campaign take on our opponent?**](https://king4ut.us/l/ozrQBQxZfeHR)
---
[ CONTRIBUTE WHAT YOU CAN ](https://king4ut.us/l/Hd2Dy3q4COad)
---
Thank you so much, Team Brian King
---
|

We'd hate to see you go, but to unsubscribe from future communications, [please click here.](https://king4ut.us/l/nzYJUcbijjpc)
---
| | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City.

[](https://king4ut.us/l/FfWw0x8ievJj)

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

Salt Lake City, UT 84158

WaPo: Democrats signal voting rights bills will top the agenda if Harris wins [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=100824_2&amount=25]
Team: HUGE news came from the Democratic Party's convention in Chicago.
Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer said he would be willing to set aside the filibuster to pass legislation that would protect and defend Americans' right to vote. If his party keeps the Senate majority, he says it will have the votes necessary to “change the rules” and make voting rights legislation a top priority, a reference to carving out an exception to the filibuster.
Remember, now-Independent Senators Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema famously preferred to keep the Senate's rule governing the filibuster in place instead of protecting our voting rights, reproductive freedoms, and so much more.
We need to make sure every American voter is aware of this promise. We need to make sure we turn out every pro-democracy voter we can to make sure this happens. Our right to vote and the foundation of our democracy depends on it.
Team: It's long past time to eliminate the Senate filibuster in favor of our fundamental right to vote. Chip in $25 or whatever you can today to show the Senate you stand for voting rights and will help turn out voters nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-the-filibuster?refcode=100824_2&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

Vice President Harris approves of altering or eliminating the filibuster to protect voting rights, so we'd need to see her elected and to give Chuck Schumer 50 U.S. Senators who would be willing to do the right thing so that the Senate can vote up and down for real and pass bills like the John Lewis Voting Rights Act and the Freedom to Vote Act.
Need proof? Chuck Schumer, in his own words: “ One of the first things I want to do, should we have the presidency and keep the majority, is change the rules and enact both the Freedom to Vote Act and the John Lewis Act. ”
We usually don't get second or third chances to pass crucial legislation. But this could give us one more at-bat to hit this out of the park . It's up to us to educate voters across the country about the implications of this important election.

Team,

If you're pro-life, you should want everyone to have access to prenatal care when they get pregnant, right?

Well here's the problem: **1 in 3 U.S. counties are considered "maternal care deserts," and abortion bans are GROWING that number**. That means pregnant patients have to travel farther for prenatal care or simply go without it.

Does that sound pro-life to you?

This is so personal for me.

**Patients deserve to access the care they need. Doctors deserve to be empowered to provide the best care they can.

Peter -

For those of you not following every detail of my Senate race, I wanted to
let you know that tonight I'll be debating my opponent, Mike Rogers, for
the first time.

As a refresher, despite painting himself as a moderate in the 20 years he
was a politician, he has done what so many have unfortunately done before
him: said whatever he thinks he needs to say to win this seat. In many
cases, that means giving up on portraying himself as a moderate and
touting Trump’s extreme positions as an election denier. In other cases,
he thinks his 20-year voting record won't matter and he has tried to
position himself as more reasonable on things like choice.

But one thing about debates is that there is a lot of preparation and
practice before the actual event.

So the last week has been all about "debate prep."

It also means there's virtually no time for fundraising. That's fine. It
is not my favorite part of the job by any stretch. But it also means I am
hoping supporters like you can help fill that gap.

It's especially important given the recent outside spending against us and
the need to be ready for anything that comes our way after the debate.

Friend, Trump sent JD Vance to Massachusetts, into our district, to share his hateful and dishonorable message with their big-money donors. [**Can you chip in to match the big money Trump and JD raised in MA06?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94571433/503926234/-1414281322?refcode=241008&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZmRmZWU4Ny1hMjg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V4Ucy2jo17F8swL67LzPv0MzVDtX7cgJnJj1EPAS_lo=) JD brought other MAGA leaders and elected officials to meet and take photos with donors who forked over $15,000 for a ticket. They think they can turn our Democratic-stronghold into a magnet for the MAGA fundraising circuit. But we know that their politics of hate and division won’t take hold here. The first lesson I learned in the Marines is the importance of integrity: you can drop out of a run or fail a test and you’ll probably get to try again, but lie about anything and you’re going home. Vance learned those same values, yet he has sold his soul to Donald Trump, a draft dodger who infamously called war heroes “suckers and losers,” and who has built his entire life on lying and cheating. Closer to his time in the Marines, Vance called Trump the “American Hitler.” A couple years later in politics, JD pronounced that Trump is “America’s last best hope.” Trump said it himself: “JD is kissing my ass, he wants my support so bad.” That’s not integrity, and Vance knows better. Under the banner of MAGA, the GOP has become the party that disrespects the flag, disparages veterans, undermines military recruitment, and shirks American global leadership. [**With your help, we can show them that our grassroots donors can match their deep-pocket MAGA donors dollar-to-dollar.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94571437/503926235/-1414281322?refcode=241008&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZmRmZWU4Ny1hMjg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V4Ucy2jo17F8swL67LzPv0MzVDtX7cgJnJj1EPAS_lo=) That support will go directly to supporting Serve America to support veterans and national-service candidates in some of the most important races across the nation. These aren’t easy wins—but they’re critical to our mission. If we want to take back the House, Democrats must win in places like...
* NH-02: where Navy Reserve veteran **Maggie Goodlander** is running to hold a Democratic seat
* VA-07: where Trump-whistleblower and Army veteran **Eugine Vindman** faces a nationally driven onslaught of MAGA attacks
* NC-01: where Air Force veteran and freshman **Rep. Don Davis** is one of the GOP’s top targets in all of Congress

Serve America’s candidates aren’t just exceptional leaders—they're high achievers. Whether they served in the Marine Corps or the Peace Corps, our candidates have a proven track record of service, character, and authenticity—and they know how to win. _**But they’re currently facing a major fundraising disadvantage, with only half as much in their campaign accounts as their GOP counterparts.**_ [**Donate now to close the GOP fundraising advantage in these critical races**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94571438/503926240/-1414281322?refcode=241008&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZmRmZWU4Ny1hMjg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V4Ucy2jo17F8swL67LzPv0MzVDtX7cgJnJj1EPAS_lo=) Serve America will be a critical part of Democrats’ work to take back the House. And with your help, our candidates have the resources they need to win. Regards, Seth

After one bad debate performance, the Times insisted that Joe Biden step aside. Months later, they are finally applying the same standard to Donald Trump

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94571447/503926307/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWQwZGQ5MGQtYTM4NS1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TAcE2A3PtFLohI2nAUVGSk7qDTkQBWC2DQu6_dmZRYs=&emci=50344906-a385-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=1d0dd90d-a385-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
We’ve been telling you something’s off at _The New York Times._
After more than a year of election coverage that often normalized Trump’s increasingly incoherent and unhinged campaign, the so-called paper of record finally published a story this weekend highlighting his declining mental state.
**[We’ll dive into why _The NYTimes_ must do even more to protect our democracy by telling the truth about Trump’s erratic behavior. But first—if you support our efforts to call out bias in the legacy media, please consider donating today to help us keep up the fight.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94571448/503926308/-260044646?refcode=20241008-EM-NYTTrump&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWQwZGQ5MGQtYTM4NS1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TAcE2A3PtFLohI2nAUVGSk7qDTkQBWC2DQu6_dmZRYs=)**
**Here’s what _The Times_ finally had to say about Donald Trump, less than 30 days from Election Day:**
_"A review of Mr. Trump’s rallies, interviews, statements, and social media posts finds signs of change since he first took the political stage in 2015. He has always been discursive and has often been untethered to truth, but with the passage of time his speeches have grown darker, harsher, longer, angrier, less focused, more profane, and increasingly fixated on the past."_
Of course, all of this has been true for a long, long time. So why is _The Times_ just now saying it?
Why have they spent so much time "sanewashing" Trump, normalizing his violent rhetoric toward immigrants and political opponents, and soft-pedaling his most unhinged moments?
**The frustration is compounded by _The Times’_ double standard. **
After one poor debate performance, they called on Joe Biden to drop out. Yet, they said nothing when Trump spewed dozens of lies, including the baseless and racist claim that immigrants were eating pets in Ohio.
They also continue to amplify the right-wing talking point that Kamala Harris lacks substance by pushing the dubious idea that undecided voters don’t trust her because she hasn’t done enough media appearances or provided enough policy details. Meanwhile, Trump is flirting with eugenics by promoting the vile notion that immigrants have inferior genetics.
Peter, don’t get us wrong—finally calling out Trump’s lack of fitness for office is a great start. But with less than 30 days to go, it’s only the beginning if The New York Times truly wants to live up to its billing as the paper of record.

clean_body: After one bad debate performance, the Times insisted that Joe Biden step aside. Months later, they are finally applying the same standard to Donald Trump Peter, We’ve been telling you something’s off at The New York Times. After more than a year of election coverage that often normalized Trump’s increasingly incoherent and unhinged campaign, the so-called paper of record finally published a story this weekend highlighting his declining mental state. = Here’s what The Times finally had to say about Donald Trump, less than 30 days from Election Day: "A review of Mr. Trump’s rallies, interviews, statements, and social media posts finds signs of change since he first took the political stage in 2015. He has always been discursive and has often been untethered to truth, but with the passage of time his speeches have grown darker, harsher, longer, angrier, less focused, more profane, and increasingly fixated on the past." Of course, all of this has been true for a long, long time. So why is The Times just now saying it? Why have they spent so much time "sanewashing" Trump, normalizing his violent rhetoric toward immigrants and political opponents, and soft-pedaling his most unhinged moments? The frustration is compounded by The Times’ double standard. After one poor debate performance, they called on Joe Biden to drop out. Yet, they said nothing when Trump spewed dozens of lies, including the baseless and racist claim that immigrants were eating pets in Ohio. They also continue to amplify the right-wing talking point that Kamala Harris lacks substance by pushing the dubious idea that undecided voters don’t trust her because she hasn’t done enough media appearances or provided enough policy details. Meanwhile, Trump is flirting with eugenics by promoting the vile notion that immigrants have inferior genetics. Peter, don’t get us wrong—finally calling out Trump’s lack of fitness for office is a great start. body:
Thousands of voters are still making up their minds. We have to reach them before they do.
---

The last message they hear right before they head to the polls could have a huge impact on their decision -- so we need to make sure they hear ours. Of course, that message could come in all sorts of ways: through an ad on TV, through a piece of mail arriving at their home, or through a conversation with a volunteer knocking on doors. Here at the Democratic National Committee, we fund a LOT of this outreach work. But at the same time, Trump and his allies are spending millions of dollars every day on voter outreach of their own. So making sure Democrats’ message is breaking through is not going to be easy. [**That’s where you come in, Derek. California may produce some of the most left-wing politicians in the country, such as Kamala Harris. But ironically, it’s also once again our key to a Republican House majority.

**Kevin Lincoln** is running in a battleground House race in CA-9 that presents one of our best opportunities to flip a Democrat-held seat in a deep blue state.

That's me in 1985 — just 24 years old at my law school graduation, fresh off a student research assistant job for Professor Laurence Tribe, thinking that I had just completed the toughest challenge of my academic career. Well, up to that point, anyway. (The bar exam was still a few weeks away).
Some years later, I would become an Assistant United States Attorney, and successfully prosecute the first FBI agent charged with espionage, Richard Miller, for spying for the Soviet Union.
As a new graduate of law school, I could never have imagined I would handle a case like that.
Or that I would later investigate a president who also betrayed our country ...
...lead his impeachment and Senate trial...
...serve on the January 6 Committee...
...get kicked off the Intelligence Committee by a craven Speaker of the House for doing the above...
...and get censured by extreme partisan MAGA House Republicans under the personal threat of that corrupt president...
Life leads us in uncertain and fortuitous ways. I’m fortunate that at a time when our country has been in trouble, and our democracy at risk, I have been in a position to help do something about it.
In the Senate, I hope to do even more.

clean_body: Hi team, can I tell you a quick story about this photo? = That's me in 1985 — just 24 years old at my law school graduation, fresh off a student research assistant job for Professor Laurence Tribe, thinking that I had just completed the toughest challenge of my academic career. Well, up to that point, anyway. (The bar exam was still a few weeks away). Some years later, I would become an Assistant United States Attorney, and successfully prosecute the first FBI agent charged with espionage, Richard Miller, for spying for the Soviet Union. As a new graduate of law school, I could never have imagined I would handle a case like that. Or that I would later investigate a president who also betrayed our country ... ...lead his impeachment and Senate trial... ...serve on the January 6 Committee... ...get kicked off the Intelligence Committee by a craven Speaker of the House for doing the above... ...and get censured by extreme partisan MAGA House Republicans under the personal threat of that corrupt president... Life leads us in uncertain and fortuitous ways. I’m fortunate that at a time when our country has been in trouble, and our democracy at risk, I have been in a position to help do something about it. Hello, folks! Welcome back to Across the Country, our weekly series from No Dem Left Behind! As we inch closer to the 2024 election, we continue to focus on the most pressing issues impacting battleground states. I’m Sabrina Niazi, and alongside my colleague Daniela Rodriguez, we are here to keep you informed about the key trends shaping the political landscape. This week, let’s turn our attention to Texas, where a multitude of political and social issues are at the forefront of the upcoming election.
---
| | | | **Texas**
---
|
---
Texas is grappling with a public health emergency as fentanyl continues to devastate communities across the state. Governor Greg Abbott has recently declared October as Fentanyl Poisoning Awareness Month in an effort to raise awareness and combat this deadly crisis. Fentanyl, a synthetic opioid, has become one of the leading causes of overdose deaths in Texas, with the crisis disproportionately affecting young adults and communities of color. In fact, fentanyl overdoses have spiked so drastically in the state that local governments are scrambling to find resources to curb the epidemic, even as Texas faces significant challenges in accessing federal assistance for this battle. But this issue is not isolated to public health—it’s become a major election topic, with candidates addressing the failure of current policies to control the spread of fentanyl in Texas. Colin Allred, the Democratic challenger running against Senator Ted Cruz, has been vocal about the need for comprehensive drug reform and increased funding for healthcare services in Texas to tackle the crisis head-on. Allred has criticized Cruz for neglecting the issue and prioritizing partisan politics over practical solutions that could save lives. Speaking of Allred, his race against Ted Cruz has narrowed significantly. With the fentanyl crisis, along with other key issues like abortion and school vouchers, coming to the forefront, Allred has gained support by presenting himself as a candidate focused on the well-being of Texas communities. His approach has resonated particularly well with voters in urban areas like Dallas and Houston, where the fentanyl crisis is most acute and where communities feel neglected by the current administration. Recent polls show Allred closing the gap, especially as national Democratic leaders, such as Bernie Sanders, have thrown their weight behind his campaign. While the race remains competitive, the growing discontent with the handling of issues like healthcare and public safety may very well tip the scales in favor of Allred. This Senate race is critical not just for Texas but for the entire country. If Allred is able to unseat Cruz, it could shift the balance of power in the Senate, opening the door for broader reforms on issues like healthcare, drug policy, and education. Moreover, the fentanyl crisis is just one example of how the state's challenges are directly linked to national policy. How Texas votes in November will not only determine its own future but will have far-reaching consequences for the U.S. as a whole. Stay tuned for our next update, where we will continue bringing you stories that matter. Stay informed with NDLB!

Hi folks,
Did you know that our district is larger than ten states? Minnesota’s 8th district is almost 30,000 square miles, stretching from the Northwest Angle down to Hugo and up to Grand Portage. It includes some of the best scenery and warmest people our state has to offer, and I’m proud to call it home.
We’ve been on the road across this vast district to rally our supporters and reach undecided voters — with less than a month to go until Election Day, it’s all hands on deck to get our message out!
And in every community I visit, I hear from voters that Pete Stauber doesn’t listen to his constituents, he doesn’t respond to their concerns, and he’s voted against our interests time and time again.
Folks are ready for a change, but we need your support NOW to ensure we can run a competitive campaign over these final weeks. Please chip in anything you can today, and check out a few recent photos from our recent campaign events below! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-october-2024?refcode=20241008]

Thanks for standing with me, and I really appreciate anything you can chip in to help sustain our momentum through Election Day. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-september-2024?refcode=20241008]
Let’s win this thing!

Minnesota’s 8th district is almost 30,000 square miles, stretching from the Northwest Angle down to Hugo and up to Grand Portage. It includes some of the best scenery and warmest people our state has to offer, and I’m proud to call it home. We’ve been on the road across this vast district to rally our supporters and reach undecided voters — with less than a month to go until Election Day, it’s all hands on deck to get our message out! And in every community I visit, I hear from voters that Pete Stauber doesn’t listen to his constituents, he doesn’t respond to their concerns, and he’s voted against our interests time and time again. Folks are ready for a change, but we need your support NOW to ensure we can run a competitive campaign over these final weeks. #TeamLizzie will continue doing all we can in the four weeks before Election Day, supporting not just our #TX07 race but also Democrats in Texas and across the country.
Lizzie and the team have been out and about across this district again this week, checking in with folks at the Fort Bend County Democratic Party HQ, joining candidates and Run Sister Run as they wrote postcards to voters in Fort Bend, dropping in to visit the West U Dems, and visiting with supporters at the 80/20 PAC’s event for its endorsed candidates.
Lizzie was thrilled to welcome our next Senator Colin Allred back to Team Lizzie HQ for a Texas Offense phone bank last week. It’s always good to have him in #TX07 as he travels the state.

said the airstrikes and ground invasion in Lebanon was meant to reach

threatening more airstrikes. All with the help of U.S. funding and weapons

power.” But this can’t just be a standoff between Bernie and Netanyahu —

It was just uncovered that Secretary of State Antony Blinken and the Biden

There’s no more time to wait. And our leaders have no excuses left to

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Thank you, _Emilia Sykes_

We have two vastly different visions for California.

My vision is one where we come together to tackle the most difficult
problems facing California. One where we provide adequate housing options,
protect the environment, put decisions about women’s reproductive rights
in their own hands instead of the government’s, and where higher education

With Donald Trump at the top of the ticket, Republicans are preparing to

| | | Here is our [full statement](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=2b1cea000b&e=43463f1dee) in response to Franklin Graham’s most recent legal threats:

In response to our first [ads](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=7a6a11428f&e=43463f1dee), Franklin Graham went on a conservative media tour calling us names and telling Christian audiences to ignore the Scripture and Donald Trump’s own words in our ads. When that failed and tens of millions of Christian voters not only listened to but shared our ads, Franklin Graham turned to a page in the Trump playbook and is trying to silence us with threats of a long and costly court process.

Franklin is scared of our [ads](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=932d9e24dd&e=43463f1dee) because we do not tell people what to do or think. We merely hold Trump’s own words up to the light of Scripture, the necessity of repentance, and Biblical warnings against leaders exactly like Trump.

Franklin knows he cannot use the words of Jesus Christ to defend or justify Trump — a strongman whose words and deeds reject truth, endorse violence, and advocate a worldview in opposition to the Fruits of the Holy Spirit (Gal 5:22-23). Indeed, his character is more reflective of the Spirits characterized as anti-christ (1 John 4:2-3, 6-21). Followers of Jesus should study closely which spirits they walk in step with (Gal 5:16-26).

Franklin has placed his hope in a man and a darkness we saw manifest when police lines were overrun at our nation’s Capitol on January 6, in Springfield this past month, and in the spirit of fear and anger fed at every Trump rally Franklin attends.

Our hope is not in any man or woman but in Christ alone. Our call is to serve, to witness Christ’s love and compassion, and to follow His example of standing between the hypocritical religious leaders and the social outcast. We know the law is on our side in this case. If Franklin follows through on his threats, we’ll see him in court.”

We invite you to [watch our ads](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=4a74096822&e=43463f1dee)[ and share with your community](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=b6559f4213&e=43463f1dee).

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

For years, I was content serving my community in other ways — whether it was defending Virginians’ civil rights as the Legal Director of the ACLU of Virginia or in my private life as an organizer and advocate for my daughter, Brooke. At only a year old, my Brooke was diagnosed with a rare genetic disorder called Rett Syndrome. I fought tooth and nail to ensure she had equal educational opportunities, took on government bureaucrats to ensure she obtained the Medicaid benefits she was entitled to and the medical treatment she desperately needed, and secured federal funding for Rett Syndrome and other rare diseases. In March of 2021, the worst thing that can happen to a parent happened: Brooke passed away in her sleep without warning. **She was five.** October marks International Rett Syndrome Awareness Month. Though there’s not a day that goes by without me thinking of her, I’m especially reminded of just how important it is to be a voice for those without one. To fight for those who can’t. **Peter, Brooke inspired me to join this fight. Now, I’m continuing to fight for you.** I’m not running for Congress to stand idly by. **I’m running to be a fighter** — for you, for our community, and for our future. I’m running to unseat a man who has voted to cut Medicare and Medicaid, let our teachers go underpaid and students underserved, and spent his nearly 4-decades long career in politics working to undermine reproductive rights. It’s not going to be easy — but critical opportunities like this rarely are. That’s why I’m asking for your help. Every dollar we raise means more voters who hear our message, more ballots cast, and greater odds that we can unseat Rob Wittman this November. Last week at the Vice Presidential Debate, JD Vance tried to backtrack on his previous stance on reproductive rights. But he’s not fooling us, and he certainly isn’t fooling Virginians.

I hate to be so direct.

But that’s the only choice I have right now. Our campaign is faltering financially. Jon Tester’s record-breaking fundraising numbers are simply burying us.

Every day, he doubles or triples our fundraising numbers, and some days, he beats us by a ratio of 10 to 1. **[Help us out.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=492291634a0842799b3b38025aee23e8&_e=MLygAXDtHYY1nZ9vUtqocz4eG17iPIgGvJoYdZ3nGMO8YMPlr233EGCR4yb-Wlf1okUzlrveEjNXuM3PI1p2TBj8pBielZSekkwe114PmTiIBEi3vm6-J_Afidw6zdgvFLsb1irVAtWYoE4NTmzqZN6XuvAV17OlLniw6VgB_MUpsWx_bRXltF8hPhXO6N73l20K6L6jYwr4AVMupvv1VFCGqvbCybXs4dgbA99NLkx6OCppVtNVvsZ_CYE3RgSIf1YM8D03mB79oj9MrElrp6t9lmaC2PN61ByG4aEU6ROQuyNsA0ihfcyfWbUPND8bF7GIerMl_Ec9coj1F4yHOSBpqXWAnbWZFH0cc1e10rVrWeneUTlWQW0hvnX44KmjkqpyqCAOXX26x-KeO38OqA%3D%3D)**

We can’t let this continue, or I will lose this race, and Montanans - and America – will be stuck with six more years of Jon Tester putting his pocketbook first and voters last.
**
We have an unbelievable opportunity in this election.**

[] [] [] October 8, 2024 • Newsletter A Practical Response to Gender Distress Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] [] Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] [] Teens are hurting. Podcast guest Pamela Garfield-Jaeger has seen it firsthand working with teens and young adults in a variety of therapeutic settings. With too many therapists "going woke" help is harder to find. A licensed clinical social worker for almost 30 years, Pamela offers parents an honest insider look at the mental health system. Her new book, "A Practical Response to Gender Distress," gives parents the information they need to make informed decisions and to help their teens. Like, Subscribe and Share! View the Podcast [] Listen to the Podcast [] Listen to the Podcast on Spotify [] [] [] Moms Should Remember "Then" Before Voting in the 2024 Presidential Election Mamas, we face possibly the most important vote of our lifetimes. The candidates couldn't be more different in vision, policies, and ability. We're looking at the background of Kamala Harris and Donald Trump this week, from their upbringing to their time spent in the White House. The history of these Presidential candidates offers a glimpse of what each may do if they earn the presidency. Get to know them and what they stand for – then get involved to cast your vote for America's future. Peter,

We’ve told you that control of the House hinges on what happens here in Washington. But you don’t have to just take our word for it.

In their recent article on what’s at stake here in the Evergreen State, here’s what _Axios_ said: “...For Democrats, defending Washington's two swing districts — the 3rd and the 8th — is crucial as they seek to flip control of the U.S. House, where Republicans hold a slim majority."
WA-08 is still a swing district, no matter what the political experts say. We know GOP voters will show up and show out for their chosen candidate. And we know with the presidential election happening this year, even more voters will be heading to the polls to make their voices heard. Point blank: **Anything can happen in these next 28 days.**

and this is why it matters:

The two most important things are time and money. Many candidates and consultants will try to sell people on how competitive their race is but if you aren't getting high; even visits or financial support its not real. Elon is a data kind of guy -- so if he doesn't think it's a winnable race I don't think he is going to throw his money away. Conversely, when you see millions being spent there is something there. This chart mirrors the list the NRCC put out of some of the most competitive races. Some are incumbents like Rep. Mike Lawler in New York that our side is trying to hold and some are open seats -- or challengers like Austin Theriault in Maine who is looking to beat a Democrat incumbent.

**Cook Political Report just DOWNGRADED our Senate race to a “TOSS UP.”**
**[If Republicans flip Wisconsin red, they’ll take back control of the Senate. Before I explain more, will you split an urgent donation between Bob Casey and my campaign to help us fight back and keep this seat blue?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241008-3?refcode=em20241008-3&refcode2=4490_552475_w2uHxK&akid=4490%2E552475%2Ew2uHxK)**

— Tammy

This number includes people up and down the ballot, from town council to U.S. Senate -- across the country, and across the political spectrum. And we know that Forward Party is a new organization, and the candidates who have accepted our endorsements are taking a risk in doing so.

You've probably heard Bill Clinton's 1992 presidential campaign slogan, _"It's the Economy, Stupid."_ Clinton's political strategist, James Carville, posted it inside campaign headquarters to keep the team focussed and on the message.

The slogan is making a comeback in 2024 as Republicans highlight Kamala Harris's dismal economic record. But if you're a freedom-loving American, we have a different slogan for you.

**"It's the Senate, Stupid."**

Conservatives are rightly focused on the presidential race this year, but winning the White House – as critical as it is – won't be enough to save the country without a conservative Senate. Without the Senate, President Trump won't be able to confirm his appointees or enact his second-term agenda.
**A Republican president without a conservative Senate is simply a waste of a Republican president.**
**[**That's why we must take action right now to help elect the best Senate candidates across the nation.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=3722d26832e140ce8af56795cce38a12&_e=ivqdg_IMRB7HQtu8a7oGH0JMvyvmA0BvbwCLaudIXx8QQXR3zR1s_DSO0MHmiq6CQtZQ05i7CXrH61ekMKV01YyfNgoV_GpE3ZXmZn2vcFhfwWDXnegTLyr-OnZM2CVDFLgRQnL3gtJy9epTQ45io6vo9lunFU14USVQnw2CEmrtuTFpz97IYq38bnvInrhmICXHvweB9GJsoz1Zwt6ZRES_Wd_KWycr0UOafvRBYUXf63LgC32rVNLrYFK0xCa26OwKiWAy20CV29gKMqyCpQ%3D%3D)**
A president can campaign on good policies, but he doesn't write the bills. As long as liberals control the Senate, good legislation will never be signed into law.

_Does anyone think Chuck Schumer will ever send bills to President Trump's desk to secure our borders, grow our economy, expand American energy, and restore election integrity?_ Of course not. If we fail to win the Senate, none of these common-sense policies will be passed. And if Kamala Harris wins, we won't be able to stop Senate Democrats from nuking the filibuster, passing their extreme agenda without debate, and creating a permanent Democrat majority.

****As we head into the final days of this election, we must support the conservatives running for U.S. Senate.**** These eight candidates believe in the principles of freedom that make America great and are willing to fight for them. They aren't liberal RINOs who will sell us out as soon as they're elected.

body:
I am not going to sit on the sidelines while a good man — Ruben Gallego — is in a tough campaign against Kari Lake here in Arizona in 2024.
#

Team, it's Mark Kelly.
It wouldn’t surprise me if some of you thought I’d take a break after my campaign in 2020.
Instead, we jumped right back into campaigning for a full term in the U.S. Senate in 2022.
We won in 2020. We won again in 2022. And I am not going to sit on the sidelines while a good man — Ruben Gallego — is in a tough campaign against Kari Lake here in Arizona in 2024.
Let me make this perfectly clear: I am not done. Not by a long shot.
Our democracy is under threat, and Arizona is the front line of that fight. I am going to do everything I can to make sure that Ruben succeeds against Kari Lake.
Tomorrow, mail-in ballots are sent out in Arizona. Early voting locations open up. And Ruben is going to take the debate stage against Kari Lake.
There are undecided voters out there who will be watching. Enough to swing the state. We’ve got to help Ruben out.

subject: HELP: Show Me A Sign (and I'll return the favor)
body:
The last month of the campaign will require we 'get the word out,' so help me do that by getting the word UP along SC-7 highways. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/d0f68a666ee1/help-show-me-a-sign-and-ill-return-the-favor?e=5d7e9a146c)

|
## I need your help: show ME a sign & I’ll return the favor

Because this is a "people's campaign" and I believe _"you cannot serve two masters,"_ I'm not taking corporate or PAC dollars in order to win a seat in Congress. My opponent, Russell Fry, loves corporate checks and PAC dollars. I’ll let him bend the knee at their feet. I’ve chosen to serve you - the voter.
The thing is - nobility comes at a price. The price my campaign pays is in limitations.
I hear all the time _"ya gotta get the word out, Mal!"_ It's true, we DO have to get the word out - but yard signs, political ads, social media marketing and billboards all come at a cost.
I'll keep it brief: my campaign and I have secured a buy for digital billboards along the Grand Strand, thanks to a nice little burst of fundraising to start the month, but the district is geographically huge - and I want to be on billboards in the Pee Dee, too.
It'll take $1500 just to get one billboard up for the final four weeks of the campaign. My math tells me if we got thirty people to donate $50, we'd get it done. Or if we have fifty donors contribute $30, we arrive at the stated goal.
Say we get twice that in donations - well, that's two boards - and us closer to defeating MAGA extremist Russell Fry and retaking the House in 2025.
Can you help? Show me a sign and I'll show you one (or more) as well. Thanks!

---
|

Any number of voices have decried Israel's continuing attacks on civilians over the past year, which have recently extended well beyond Gaza to include [Syria](https://substack.com/redirect/6be9d56b-d7cf-4221-a0c5-fc37b493c3d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Iran](https://substack.com/redirect/3f1ae714-852f-40d0-9ada-c178cd03ad00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Yemen](https://substack.com/redirect/090a2e03-1b4f-4a1f-9b47-03011507938d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [Lebanon](https://substack.com/redirect/e6524026-4f1d-44c0-9127-09307a67755e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). As Israel's targets have expanded, the country's leadership has remained committed to state terrorism violating international human rights. Over the course of [three days last weekend](https://substack.com/redirect/06e87217-24a2-4c5e-a29c-8f573a676069?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Israel bombed civilian targets including a mosque, a school and a hospital.
The first post in this series addressed the [historical roots](https://substack.com/redirect/f7b84305-0043-4ce6-8b14-58ebde5e7f26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the continuing Israeli genocide targeting Palestinians in Gaza, and the disturbing inversion of America's role with respect to international human rights over the past 75 years. This post will examine the Netanyahu regime that continues to lead Israel--and the rest of the world--into an expanding world war.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6eafe1f3-c680-444d-b129-b3f7689f142a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As it happens, I'll be guest hosting the "Redneck Gone Green" podcast this afternoon and again next Tuesday. I had the pleasure of [joining host David Cobb a few weeks ago](https://substack.com/redirect/cb850c65-7c1a-4260-b385-44ffa081ce09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and am helping out over the next week while he handles some personal affairs. Today's discussion will feature [Stephen Semler](https://substack.com/@stephensemler/posts), Co-Founder of the Security Policy Reform Institute, a grassroots-funded, U.S. foreign policy think tank, and writer of the [Polygraph](https://substack.com/redirect/221f33cb-45b1-4fbd-bc19-8870afeaa157?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) newsletter on Substack.
[Tune in at 3pm PT today](https://substack.com/redirect/96422b09-7a4f-4b54-82f3-d50f5e1dab61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### **Attacks on civilians populations are war crimes**
International law unambiguously prohibits attacks by states targeting civilian populations. They are international crimes, rising to the level of terrorism when they aim to strike fear into those populations, for instance, in order to drive them off of land they have historically inhabited.
This summer, at the [request](https://substack.com/redirect/fe7de6e1-2127-4105-827f-7e13de5e4747?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the United Nations General Assembly backed by the majority of countries around the world, the International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruled that Israel's treatment of Palestinians has [violated international law](https://substack.com/redirect/87abaa64-566d-4e7a-8bad-d53aa93689d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in several ways. The ICJ held that Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territories amounted to "de facto annexation," while also holding illegal Israeli exploitation of Palestinian natural resources, as well as Israel's systematic discrimination against Palestinians.
Israel has used [mass starvation](https://substack.com/redirect/557db875-6dd7-42d6-ad98-31c20a0152d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as a weapon of war, while relentlessly [bombing civilian targets](https://substack.com/redirect/856cd7e5-b847-4111-8ab0-04b463561b54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) including hospitals and schools and [assassinating random Palestinians](https://substack.com/redirect/a1825df7-8df6-463e-84ba-45625a4f9f33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), seemingly for sport. Under Netanyahu's leadership, Israeli soldiers have [murdered journalists](https://substack.com/redirect/353d1a14-7d48-4314-a4f1-ed91a80b792a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [students](https://substack.com/redirect/4e10defd-0361-47c4-8d7e-23068a25f11f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), including [Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/16ac212d-1634-443a-a62c-a2c3e75dcee5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and other international observers. Israel has [raided and shut down](https://substack.com/redirect/271e2687-8722-47dd-be83-10f4fc5dfd35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) entire bureaus of news organizations in order to [hide its crimes](https://substack.com/redirect/535e9ade-433e-4c4e-a0ef-746b5dbea3bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from the prying eyes of the world, even while claiming to respect international human rights that it continues to degrade and abuse with impunity.

### **Netanyahu was nearly removed from office for corruption before politically weaponizing the genocide**
Many observers have forgotten the recent history that preceded the escalation of Israel's genocide last October. But the protests that rocked Israel for months in early 2023 have played a key role in motivating Netanyahu's escalating state violence since then.
The crisis began with Netanyahu proposing [judicial reforms](https://substack.com/redirect/7d760917-f7aa-4bfa-bf88-8a2f1ccbe6de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to consolidate his political control over the country, marginalizing courts as independent checks and balances and shifting Israel even further from the democracy it claims to be into the apartheid state that its actions increasingly reveal to the rest of the world.
Israeli civil society responded courageously, mobilizing [mass protests](https://substack.com/redirect/14622161-e272-4c75-ac3f-3c3cb17e8c07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) unprecedented in the country's history. For American observers, it would be fair to draw a comparison between Netanyahu's domestic constitutional belligerence and that of Donald Trump, to whom we will return shortly.
_Chronicles of a Dying Empire is a publication supported by readers, rather than advertisers. To receive new posts,**sign up for a free subscription!** To support my work challenging bipartisan corruption from Washington to San Francisco, please consider becoming a paid subscriber._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..gAbi5PtB2cpBUM69d-eMtFiec_XwyaQ_ZoVJAXIsGFc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=149984001)
A month before the [Hamas attacks](https://substack.com/redirect/81c1d8af-0b22-4391-b249-5a4c874b1234?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on October 10 that shocked the Israeli security establishment, the _New York Times_ [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/95fd8247-faa0-4a7f-8d8c-81b480b905eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that:
> Benjamin Netanyahu, the Israeli prime minister, landed in the United States on Monday an embattled man, dogged by months of mass protests against his efforts to reduce the power of Israel's Supreme Court.
> He leaves on Saturday revitalized and potentially emboldened. Through six days of high-level meetings with world leaders and tech entrepreneurs, analysts said Mr. Netanyahu improved his strained relationship with President Biden and polished his reputation as a heavyweight player on the global state.
> And he nudged criticism of his judicial overhaul into the background as a landmark diplomatic deal between Israel and Saudi Arabia appeared to gain momentum.
Washington's role in enabling Netanyahu's continuing [corruption](https://substack.com/redirect/9d4df83b-8533-4e5f-9ef4-5fffa09a5485?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and international belligerence cannot possibly be overstated. But that is only half the story. While Washington may be the global power and Israel its regional proxy, the relationship between the two today resembles a tail wagging the dog.
### **Netanyahu is thumbing his nose at Washington, banking on a Trump victory**
Throughout the past year, Biden has articulated various supposed "red lines" that Netanyahu has repeatedly disregarded. Calls to allow humanitarian aid to reach civilian populations were ignored, as were multiple ceasefire agreements facilitated by American diplomats.
Israel's willingness to ignore agreements supported by Washington represents a critical historical change from the previous baseline. Conservatives often lionize Ronald Raegan, who was ironically [proud of asserting limits on Israel's influence](https://substack.com/redirect/4ee9fa83-2de4-4784-8286-697bfdd6ceb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over U.S. foreign policy. For instance, Raegan allowed nearly [two dozen U.S. resolutions](https://substack.com/redirect/de812dfe-90c1-4c8a-8d70-01922c68d454?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to pass despite being critical of Israel, suspended the delivery of some advanced jets to Israel in response to Israel's surprise bombing of targets in Iraq, and also began selling advanced reconnaissance & surveillance planes to Saudi Arabia over Israeli objections.
In the time since then, every U.S. president has lost independence to Israel, growing more and more beholden to its leadership and less and less responsive to public opinion among voters. By the time Obama left the White House, he had thoroughly solidified the co-option of Democrats by the military industrial complex, going so far as to emulate the [random assassinations](https://substack.com/redirect/db506c2c-aaec-467f-8d81-7b60be483f0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that have made the Netanyahu regime internationally infamous.
At the moment, one aspect of the crisis that many observers overlook is Netanyahu's calculus about the results of the 2024 U.S. presidential election. Netanyahu has repeatedly ignored Biden, embarrassing him time and again by violating supposed red lines and scuttling multiple potential ceasefire agreements that Biden's advisors helped negotiate.
Why? Because Netanyahu is banking on a Trump victory, either at the polls in November, or when the White House changes hands in January.
Trump has told Jewish voters that those backing Harris "[need to have their heads examined](https://substack.com/redirect/7308bc74-98c5-42e1-8a4d-7d1f0ea0ca4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," because he intends to release whatever vestigial restraints Washington might still have over Israel's foreign policy and turn Netanyahu loose.
Trump made [similar promises](https://substack.com/redirect/62a694e0-4086-49e5-852f-1ecf3fb0e9c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the CIA headquarters soon after becoming president. Coups resulted in several Latin American countries that professional journalists have lacked the independence to investigate.
Recall that Trump has already pledged not to respect the outcome of the 2024 vote, and is likely poised to insist on his victory even if the votes reveal a Democratic victory, like in 2020. Netanyahu's reliance on Trump, then, might appear to represent an attack on democracy in America.
But don't expect any politicians or journalists in Washington to recognize that.

Sen. Sanders and Rep. AOC visited TX-35 this week!
Peter,
**Texas is fired up!** Last week, I hosted Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio Cortez in my district as part of the Our Fight Our Future tour.
We held four rallies across the I-35 corridor to mobilize Texans ahead of November. We were joined by thousands of Texans who are fired up and ready for a progressive agenda for workers rights, abortion rights, economic justice, climate action, and more.

Hi,

**My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. And I’m officially running to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.**

Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.

But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.

**I've set an ambitious goal to raise $25,000 by midnight to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it.[Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and DASS right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94583323/503967076/-1094303316?refcode=em-10.8.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTllNWRhOS1jMDg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Jf0s7Vo3sNU-OKE9rKBkXJAX0gemEG3lJVsGnB7Hw40=)**

**When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America.** We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.

Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.

**My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to _destroy_ the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.**

Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide ban on abortions. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare benefits that so many rely on.

**That’s why I’m running to defeat him this November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, friend,_we can take him down._**

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Since this time last year, Justice Democrats and our elected leaders in
Congress have led the call for an immediate, permanent ceasefire, the
return of Israeli and Palestinian hostages, and the de-escalation of
violence to prevent an all-out regional war in the Middle East.

Unfortunately, the majority of U.S. officials — who take thousands or even
millions of dollars in campaign contributions from anti-Palestinian lobby
group AIPAC — have not joined this call for peace. Meanwhile, the White
House has enabled far-right Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to
not only carry out genocide against Palestinians in Gaza and the West
Bank, but also to bomb and invade Lebanon.

In one year, the Israeli military has killed at least 41,000 Palestinians
— that’s 1 out of every 55 people in Gaza, with 69% of victims being women
and children. In Lebanon, the death toll rises daily, with more than 1,300
people killed so far in the past month. As long as our country continues
to send bombs and weapons to Israel, this violence will not end.

Currently, only seventeen leaders in Congress have demanded the U.S. halt
arms transfers to Israel, and ten out of the twelve House members are
Justice Democrats incumbents.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241008-arms-embargo/?source=em20241008-36053&akid=36053%2E1203867%2EOAfTFr ]Tweet from Prem Thakker: 17 members of Congress calling to stop weapons
(in some form) to Israel. With US aid, Israeli forces have killed 42,000+
people: Palestinians & Lebanese, Americans like WCK worker Jacob
Flickinger & Aysenur Eygi; hundreds of journalists, volunteers, doctors
from around the world

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241008-arms-embargo/?source=em20241008-36053&akid=36053%2E1203867%2EOAfTFr ]Our progressive candidates are leading the call for an immediate arms
embargo. Will you add your name to join them in demanding the U.S. stop
sending bombs and weapons to Israel’s military?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241008-arms-embargo/?source=em20241008-36053&akid=36053%2E1203867%2EOAfTFr ]Take Action

The sooner our leaders stop enabling Israel’s far-right government, the
more lives we can save and the sooner we can achieve peace.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Y’all, I really, truly, never imagined that I’d end up in politics. Growing up, I never thought about “party” or “partisanship.” It just wasn’t something my parents (both lifelong Republicans) talked about. Here’s what they did teach me: **that everyone deserves a fair shot; to help the people in my community who need it; and that all people are worthy of dignity and respect.** That’s why I spent nearly thirty years as a special education teacher — to make sure kids who needed an advocate in school had one. And after I saw the toll that losing health care coverage took on members of my family, it’s why I ran for office, even though I was in a district drawn by the GOP for a Republican. _I won that election by just 288 votes._ The GOP candidate didn’t think they had to compete, so they just ignored me. That was their mistake. And it’s why Marsha Blackburn isn’t ignoring our campaign now. Marsha knows that she has a real fight ahead to keep her hold on power. clean_body: That’s it. | Y’all, I really, truly, never imagined that I’d end up in politics. Growing up, I never thought about “party” or “partisanship.” It just wasn’t something my parents (both lifelong Republicans) talked about. Here’s what they did teach me: that everyone deserves a fair shot; to help the people in my community who need it; and that all people are worthy of dignity and respect. That’s why I spent nearly thirty years as a special education teacher — to make sure kids who needed an advocate in school had one. And after I saw the toll that losing health care coverage took on members of my family, it’s why I ran for office, even though I was in a district drawn by the GOP for a Republican. I won that election by just 288 votes. The GOP candidate didn’t think they had to compete, so they just ignored me. That was their mistake. And it’s why Marsha Blackburn isn’t ignoring our campaign now. Marsha knows that she has a real fight ahead to keep her hold on power. That’s why she’s attacking me. Fellow American - Senator Deb Fischer is a strong conservative voice in Nebraska who constantly stands up to the dangerous, damaging efforts of Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, and Democrats in the U.S. Senate.

Democrats have counted on their razor-thin Senate majority to push a host of bad policies through Congress – higher taxes and spending, trillions in new debt, record inflation and energy costs, weaponized federal bureaucracies, open borders invasion, foreign policy fiascos, and chaos abroad.

Since she’s been such a conservative warrior for Republicans, **Democrats are throwing MILLIONS against her to try and take her seat. They’ve orchestrated an _"independent"_ candidate who is raising a lot of money on ActBlue and coming after this race.**

It is ESSENTIAL that we re-elect Deb Fischer in Nebraska, _for a strong Senate Majority that will serve as the firewall for freedom._

body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/aa7f7fb4e6d6/dave-min-signs-defaced-with-anti-asian-hate-speech-in-huntington-beach-18229430?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** October 8, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Dave Min Signs Defaced With Anti-Asian Hate Speech in Huntington Beach**
**IRVINE, CA** — Last night, a number of Dave Min for Congress signs in Huntington Beach were vandalized with anti-Asian racist slurs. Supporters who live nearby discovered the vandalized signs while walking their kids to school this morning. A report has been filed with the Huntington Beach Police, who are investigating these hate crimes.
[A Video Of The Signs Is Available Here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=e92a1498d9&e=7017cc100e)
---
|
---
| _In response, Senator Min released the following statement:_ **“Hate of any kind, directed against anyone, is unacceptable. Full stop. But unfortunately, we have seen a sharp rise in hate in recent years due to the xenophobia and racism that have come to define Donald Trump’s MAGA movement. We’ve all seen and heard Trump’s anti-Asian rhetoric and his racist comments about Haitian immigrants. Locally, Orange County residents are being bombarded with Scott Baugh and MAGA Republican hit pieces baselessly claiming I want to create open borders because I’m the child of immigrants. ** **It is saddening, but not surprising, that we are seeing this type of anti-Asian hate in the immediate aftermath of the Trump MAGA event in Huntington Beach this weekend. This type of hate speech does not represent the values of Orange County, and I urge my fellow Orange County elected officials to join me in condemning it.”** Min, the son of Korean immigrants and the former Vice Chair of the Asian and Pacific Islander Legislative Caucus, has been a leading voice against anti-Asian hate since he took office in December 2020. Min is endorsed by leading Asian-American advocacy groups including ASPIRE PAC, AAPI Victory Fund, Asian American Action Fund and Asian American Forward. ### _California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=3fca2b3c4c&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44%. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._
---
