Hi Peter,
**Big news:** Kamala Harris just announced **a major new plan called Medicare at Home to help "sandwich generation" families** struggling to afford the skyrocketing costs of caring for aging parents and young children.
In what would be [**the largest boost in federal support for caregiving in American history,**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94585181/503973056/-801043699?ms=100824_HarrisCareAnnouncement&utm_campaign=careagenda&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YjM5MjVlZS1jNjg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sLnH9a8PrtP40uAA4inZtY0jj_tIS93f4nBbvFupL_g=&emci=08dae9b8-b885-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=4b3925ee-c685-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787) Harris' historic proposal would help, for the first time, seniors and people with disabilities on Medicare. This proposal would allow them to receive care at home, by providing much needed financial assistance and reducing emotional stress to families all while allowing for seniors to live independently in their own homes.
To make this exciting new proposal a reality, we need all hands on deck to talk to voters about the critical role of care in this election and beyond.
[**To celebrate today’s big announcement, check out events happening online and across the country.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94585186/503973060/2136787208?ms=100824_HarrisCareAnnouncement&utm_campaign=careagenda&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YjM5MjVlZS1jNjg1LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sLnH9a8PrtP40uAA4inZtY0jj_tIS93f4nBbvFupL_g=&emci=08dae9b8-b885-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=4b3925ee-c685-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)

clean_body: Big news: Kamala Harris just announced a major new plan to help "sandwich generation" families. Hi Peter, Big news: Kamala Harris just announced a major new plan called Medicare at Home to help "sandwich generation" families struggling to afford the skyrocketing costs of caring for aging parents and young children. In what would be Harris' historic proposal would help, for the first time, seniors and people with disabilities on Medicare. This proposal would allow them to receive care at home, by providing much needed financial assistance and reducing emotional stress to families all while allowing for seniors to live independently in their own homes. To make this exciting new proposal a reality, we need all hands on deck to talk to voters about the critical role of care in this election and beyond. Access to quality, affordable care at home should not be an issue left for families to deal with on their own. Let's do this, The Care in Action Team

Happy October! With just **28 more days until Election Day** , your support and help with our campaign means so much to our team.
**Mark Your Calendars:** Coming up this week, Hogan for Maryland will have multiple opportunities for you to join Governor Hogan on the campaign trail.
* **Thursday, October 10th:** Join Hogan of Maryland team members and fellow supporters to watch Thursday’s debate at watch parties across the state.

* _Anne Arundel County | West End Bar & Grill, 2049 West St., Annapolis, MD_
* _Frederick County | 5112 Pegasus Ct., Ste. F, Frederick, MD_
* _Howard County | 3240 Corporate Ct., Ste. B, Ellicott City, MD_

* _Prince George's County | 3501 Perry St., Mt. Rainier, MD_
* _St. Mary's County | Social on Fenwick, 41655 Fenwick St., Leonardtown, MD_

* **All debate watch parties begin at 7:00 PM.** Let us know you plan on coming by RSVPing [here](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=ba75cfec33&e=3ef74f1f93).

* **Saturday, October 12th:** Walk with Governor Hogan in the Autumn Glory Parade in Garrett County!
* Parade line up begins at 11:00 AM! For more information and to **sign up to join us, click**[**here**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=5313a4b070&e=3ef74f1f93).

* **Sunday, October 13th:** Ravens vs Commanders Tailgate at M&T Bank Stadium
* Join Governor Hogan and our team by the Hogan for Maryland bus ahead of the Ravens-Commanders game in Baltimore!
* Tailgating starts at 11:00 AM at M&T Bank Stadium, 1101 Russell St, Baltimore, MD 21230 — we hope to see you there!

We are beyond grateful for your enthusiastic support for our campaign, and look forward to seeing you out on the campaign trail in the next 28 days.
To stay up to date on all of Governor Hogan’s travels and announcements, follow his social media pages on [Facebook](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=5fdda461c5&e=3ef74f1f93), [Twitter](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=5da78f5495&e=3ef74f1f93), and [Instagram](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=6e92629cef&e=3ef74f1f93) — and don’t forget to amplify!

Rob**Team Hogan**

name: Leteria, Team Jill Stein
subject: My undocumented story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=1)
---
Peter,

I became an orphan at 8 years old. My mother, Zingha Natalee Taylor, had been battling HIV/AIDS for months unbeknownst to me.

Born to her in Montego Bay, Jamaica, when she was only 15, my mother struggled to raise me on her own. By the time I was five, I had already faced the horrors of abuse while being shuffled between different households.

When my mother passed away on May 17, 2001, I felt as though I had lost everything.

When my aunt in America offered to take me in, I thought it was too good to be true. But soon I was on a plane, heading to the United States.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=2)
---
In America, I thrived. My aunt and uncle formally adopted me. I excelled in school, became class president, and lived out what felt like a second chance at life.

It wasn’t until I applied for college that I discovered the harsh reality of being undocumented.

I learned that I did not have a social security number and that my future in higher education might be out of reach. I felt defeated, but I was determined to find another way.

In 2012, hope emerged through the Dream Act and the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program. Like millions of others, I was one of the fortunate young people to receive DACA protection and a chance to pursue my dreams.

My journey was far from smooth. My world was shattered again when I lost my adoptive mother to breast cancer in 2013 – just days after Christmas and her 58th birthday.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=3)
---
I was 20 years old and on my own once again. I experienced homelessness, and I was still faced with the lingering uncertainty of my immigration status.

I lived in constant fear of deportation, separation from my family, and the possibility of losing the life I had worked so hard to build.

Today I am blessed with a beautiful family, a thriving career, and the support of a community that fights alongside me for the rights of all immigrants.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=4)
---
**That fight is important, because my story is not unique. It is the story of millions of undocumented immigrants facing similar fears and uncertainties.

** We live in a constant state of limbo, where our livelihoods are threatened by outdated immigration policies and inconsistent reforms. The Trump administration heightened those fears, and even now, under new leadership, DACA recipients like me continue to live without a clear path to citizenship.

I choose to use my voice to advocate for _comprehensive_ immigration reform – a reform that doesn’t just offer temporary relief but creates a permanent pathway to citizenship for Dreamers and all undocumented individuals. **I believe that Jill Stein, who has consistently supported immigrant rights, offers hope for real change.

** Stein’s 2024 campaign is a beacon for those of us who feel left behind by the system. She advocates for [**humane immigration policies**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/immigration?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=5) , including dismantling ICE, offering permanent residency to DACA recipients, and creating a sanctuary for all immigrants, regardless of status.

Jill Stein also recognizes the intersectionality of immigration and climate justice. As climate change displaces millions globally, more people will be forced to migrate, seeking safety and opportunity in countries like the U.S.

Stein’s commitment to addressing climate change through bold policies like a [**REAL Green New Deal**](https://jillsteinforpresident.nationbuilder.com/r?u=tnCv4JfsA24JYqaqIJinbXtuAAYb7BVwyWAN3CMJYpkx_u85ElnHf_AjLF58zEalPTQTmPGJ4BiTIva5-JO6bg&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=6) is crucial. A stable climate and equitable immigration policies go hand in hand, as many immigrants are fleeing environmental devastation in their home countries.

**[If you agree that we need a comprehensive immigration plan rooted in human rights and dignity, please join me in supporting Jill Stein and Butch Ware for President and Vice President.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=7)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=8 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=8)
---
For people like me, who have already endured so much, it is critical that we elect leaders who understand these connections. Leaders who see that our fight for citizenship is tied to our right to live on a healthy planet. Stein’s vision of a just, sustainable future – one where immigrants are welcomed and protected – is the hope I cling to.

I dream of the day I can travel with my children without fear.

The day I won’t have to worry if my DACA will be renewed.

The day my existence won’t be questioned as "illegal."
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=9)
---
Jill Stein’s campaign speaks to that dream. Her policies reflect a future where I, and millions like me, can live without fear, contribute fully to society, and thrive on a planet that values both its people and its environment.

I am undocumented and unafraid, but I cannot do it alone. We need leaders who will fight for us, who will protect the environment, and who will reform immigration policies so that people like me can live freely and fully.

**[That’s who Jill Stein is, and I stand ready to support her vision for a just, sustainable, and inclusive future.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=10)**

Thank you,

Leteria Bailey
for Team Jill Stein
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=11 "Support Jill Today!") [Support Jill Today!](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=undocumented&n=11)
---

Voting has already started in Montana—and there are just a few weeks until Election Day. This is it.
If you’ve been waiting for the best time to make your first donation to win this Senate race, that time is right now.
Make a split donation of $10 -- between my campaign and Seth Moulton -- before midnight to help me fight back against Mitch McConnell’s attacks, reach as many Montana voters as we can, and win this race. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-tester]

My multimillionaire opponent Tim Sheehy is wrong for Montana. He wants to return health care to “pure privatization”, rip away women’s freedom to choose, and transfer off our public lands.
Tim Sheehy is a rich out-of-stater who doesn’t know the first thing about Montana values. But he’s already dropped $2.5 million of his personal wealth to defeat me, and this race is too close for comfort.
Election Day is almost here, and I need your help to fight back against his attacks. Split any amount now between my campaign and Seth Moulton to help me continue defending our Montana way of life >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-tester]

When I ran for governor of Minnesota in 2018, I promised my son that if we won we would finally welcome a puppy into our home. I didn’t think much of it at the time, but as any parent knows, kids remember _everything._ _When my race was called, I knew that I had to make good on my promise._ So a few weeks later, we rescued Scout from a litter in Oklahoma. We had the space in our home and our hearts, and it’s not an exaggeration to say that he filled that vacancy perfectly. The truth is that Scout rescued us just as much as we rescued him. Having him in my life has made me a better person and leader. He’s loyal, he gives unconditional love, and he reminds me of the empathy we have the power to show each other every single day. **Looking back, keeping my word to my family was one of the most important things I’ve ever done. I will always follow through on my promises, no matter how big or small. That’s why I mean it when I say that I’m prepared to keep my promises if Kamala and I are elected.** [**The only way we can win this fight is if folks like you pitch in a few bucks to our campaign for the first time today. clean_body: Scout changed my life. Now it’s up to us to change the course of our country and our democracy for the better. | | | Peter, It’s hard to believe looking at us now, but bringing our dog Scout into the family took some convincing. When I ran for governor of Minnesota in 2018, I promised my son that if we won we would finally welcome a puppy into our home. I didn’t think much of it at the time, but as any parent knows, kids remember everything. When my race was called, I knew that I had to make good on my promise. So a few weeks later, we rescued Scout from a litter in Oklahoma. We had the space in our home and our hearts, and it’s not an exaggeration to say that he filled that vacancy perfectly. The truth is that Scout rescued us just as much as we rescued him. Having him in my life has made me a better person and leader. He’s loyal, he gives unconditional love, and he reminds me of the empathy we have the power to show each other every single day. Looking back, keeping my word to my family was one of the most important things I’ve ever done. I will always follow through on my promises, no matter how big or small. That’s why I mean it when I say that I’m prepared to keep my promises if Kamala and I are elected. _* Sent in support of Ruben Gallego for Arizona and Lucas Kunce for Missouri *_
Peter —
My family means the world to me.
In my mom and my sisters, I see the American dream.
My mom worked her whole life to provide for us. My sisters went to college and built successful lives in service to their own families and communities.
We started with next to nothing. No money. No connections. But we made it, because the American dream is still alive.
There’s no doubt that it’s become more difficult to pursue, though. After I left the Marines, I knew my service to our country wasn’t over. I’ve dedicated the last 20 years of my life to strengthening the American dream and delivering for people who need help.
But people like Kari Lake, like Donald Trump, they’re only out for themselves. They’ll attack anyone who doesn’t fall in line. They’ll stop at nothing in their pursuit of power and influence.
This November is our best shot at rejecting the politics of Kari Lake and Donald Trump. I’m ready to do whatever I can to get us across the finish line, to defend Arizona and everything we’ve accomplished. But I can’t do this alone.
Please, Peter. Arizona starts voting tomorrow. We’re going all out to reach voters before they submit their ballots, and I need your help.

# House Majority Leader Steve Scalise and Republican Alaska At-Large Candidate Nick Begich Release Joint Statement Supporting Unleashing American Energy
---
|
### _To Lower Prices and Fix Our Economy, We Must Unleash American Energy_
---
|
---
|
##
Contact: [Tyler Daniel](mailto:tyler@peaksandvalleys.llc), [Maddy Vogel](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=e21d0c2b52&e=6679001ba0)

**Washington, DC** – Today, [Must Read Alaska reported](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=be2fdb4b77&e=6679001ba0) House Majority Leader Steve Scalise received a letter from Republican Alaska At-Large Candidate Nick Begich regarding the prioritization of Alaskan interests in the first budget reconciliation bill. In response to the letter, Leader Scalise released the following statement: _“Energy production in our country has been crippled by the Biden-Harris Administration and Alaska’s production capacity is no exception. Democrat leadership and their failed policies have stunted growth. While Mary Peltola has enabled the Left’s radical agenda for two years, Nick Begich is already committed to securing a prosperous future for Alaska. In every conversation we have, he's reaffirmed his commitment to correcting the failed Biden-Harris agenda by passing as many pro-energy policies as possible in the first reconciliation bill of the new Congress. We need Nick in Washington to lower prices, fix our economy, and unleash American energy.”_ The letter, dated October 8th, from Nick Begich to Leader Scalise is below: _“Majority Leader Steve Scalise,_ _“I respectfully request that House Republican Leadership prioritize Alaska and its ability to develop its vast natural resources in the 119th Congress’ first budget reconciliation bill. This is more important than ever, particularly after the Biden-Harris Administration has weaponized the administrative state to limit Alaska’s ability to produce and manage our resources. The Biden-Harris Administration has taken 66 actions, through executive orders and otherwise, that have limited our ability to make decisions in not only our own best interests, but those of the country. I seek to work with House Republican Leadership through the reconciliation process to provide certainty for generations of Alaskans to come. _ _“While I understand there are limitations, it is time for us to be bold and, as such, I request to collaboratively work with your team to include as much as possible within the parameters of the reconciliation process subject to the support of the House Republican Conference. After the reconciliation process, our work will not be done. As you know, energy security is national security, and it is critical for the 119th Congress to prioritize unleashing American energy. Therefore, I respectfully request to continue to work with your team through the Congress on subsequent legislation to further unburden Alaska from federal government overreach. _ _Alaska's resource development is critical to the state's economy and nation’s energy security. The uncertainty created by certain executive actions has stalled essential projects, reduced investment, increased energy costs, and contributed to the increase in costs on everyday goods. Codifying protections for Alaska’s resource industries will stimulate job creation, ensure regulatory clarity, and boost national economic growth._ _“We have a rare opportunity to decisively end decades of political maneuvering that have impeded Alaska’s economic potential. By leading this charge, House Republicans can demonstrate their commitment to economic growth, energy dominance, and limiting executive overreach. I am confident that with your leadership, we can unify Alaska and Congress around our shared principles, benefiting all Americans for generations to come._ _Thank you for your consideration of this urgent matter. I look forward to working with you to secure Alaska's future._ _“Sincerely,_ _Nicholas J. Begich III_ _Candidate for Congress, AK-AL”_ ###

clean_body: Huge benefits for Alaska! | | | | | | | | House Majority Leader Steve Scalise and Republican Alaska At-Large Candidate Nick Begich Release Joint Statement Supporting Unleashing American Energy | To Lower Prices and Fix Our Economy, We Must Unleash American Energy | | Contact: mailto:tyler@peaksandvalleys.llc, Washington, DC – Today, House Majority Leader Steve Scalise received a letter from Republican Alaska At-Large Candidate Nick Begich regarding the prioritization of Alaskan interests in the first budget reconciliation bill. In response to the letter, Leader Scalise released the following statement: “Energy production in our country has been crippled by the Biden-Harris Administration and Alaska’s production capacity is no exception. Democrat leadership and their failed policies have stunted growth. While Mary Peltola has enabled the Left’s radical agenda for two years, Nick Begich is already committed to securing a prosperous future for Alaska. In every conversation we have, he's reaffirmed his commitment to correcting the failed Biden-Harris agenda by passing as many pro-energy policies as possible in the first reconciliation bill of the new Congress. We need Nick in Washington to lower prices, fix our economy, and unleash American energy.” The letter, dated October 8th, from Nick Begich to Leader Scalise is below: “Majority Leader Steve Scalise, “I respectfully request that House Republican Leadership prioritize Alaska and its ability to develop its vast natural resources in the 119th Congress’ first budget reconciliation bill. This is more important than ever, particularly after the Biden-Harris Administration has weaponized the administrative state to limit Alaska’s ability to produce and manage our resources. The Biden-Harris Administration has taken 66 actions, through executive orders and otherwise, that have limited our ability to make decisions in not only our own best interests, but those of the country. I seek to work with House Republican Leadership through the reconciliation process to provide certainty for generations of Alaskans to come. “While I understand there are limitations, it is time for us to be bold and, as such, I request to collaboratively work with your team to include as much as possible within the parameters of the reconciliation process subject to the support of the House Republican Conference. After the reconciliation process, our work will not be done. As you know, energy security is national security, and it is critical for the 119th Congress to prioritize unleashing American energy. Therefore, I respectfully request to continue to work with your team through the Congress on subsequent legislation to further unburden Alaska from federal government overreach. Alaska's resource development is critical to the state's economy and nation’s energy security. The uncertainty created by certain executive actions has stalled essential projects, reduced investment, increased energy costs, and contributed to the increase in costs on everyday goods. Codifying protections for Alaska’s resource industries will stimulate job creation, ensure regulatory clarity, and boost national economic growth. “We have a rare opportunity to decisively end decades of political maneuvering that have impeded Alaska’s economic potential. By leading this charge, House Republicans can demonstrate their commitment to economic growth, energy dominance, and limiting executive overreach. I am confident that with your leadership, we can unify Alaska and Congress around our shared principles, benefiting all Americans for generations to come. Thank you for your consideration of this urgent matter. I look forward to working with you to secure Alaska's future. “Sincerely, Nicholas J.
